title: Memorization In Stable Diffusion Is Unexpectedly Driven by CLIP Embeddings
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 Findings. Code is available at https://github.com/quasar529/sd-clip-mem
summary: Understanding how textual embeddings contribute to memorization in text-to-image diffusion models is crucial for both interpretability and safety. This paper investigates an unexpected behavior of CLIP embeddings in Stable Diffusion, revealing that the model disproportionately relies on specific embeddings. We categorize input tokens as <startoftext>, <prompt>, <endoftext> and <pad> with corresponding embeddings $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{sot}}, \mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pr}}, \mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}, \mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pad}}$. We discover that $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pr}}$ contribute minimally to generation in memorized cases. In contrast, $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pad}}$ strongly affect memorization due to their structural duplication of $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}$, the only embedding explicitly optimized during CLIP training. This duplication unintentionally amplifies the influence of $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}$, causing the model to over-rely on it, thereby driving memorization. Based on these observations, we propose two simple yet effective inference-time mitigation strategies: (1) Replacing the tokenizer's default <pad> from <eot> to the ! token before embedding, and masking the $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{eot}}$; (2) Partial masking of $\mathbf{v}^{\mathbf{pad}}$. Both suppress memorization without degrading quality, and are readily deployable without prior detection.

AI.tldr: 本文发现文本到图像扩散模型中CLIP嵌入的<pad>令牌因结构性地复制了<eot>嵌入，导致模型过度依赖该嵌入从而引发记忆化问题，并提出了两种无需检测即可部署的推理时缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 理解文本嵌入如何导致文本到图像扩散模型中的记忆化问题，对于模型的可解释性和安全性至关重要。
AI.method: 通过分析CLIP嵌入在Stable Diffusion中的行为，发现<pr>嵌入在记忆化案例中贡献最小，而<pad>嵌入因结构性地复制<eot>嵌入（CLIP训练中唯一被显式优化的嵌入）而放大了其影响。基于此，提出两种推理时缓解策略：(1) 将tokenizer默认的<pad>从<eot>替换为!令牌，并屏蔽<eot>嵌入；(2) 部分屏蔽<pad>嵌入。
AI.result: 两种策略均能有效抑制记忆化，且不损害生成质量，可无需前置检测直接部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单修改推理过程中的嵌入处理方式，即可显著缓解文本到图像扩散模型的记忆化问题。

title: Reasoning-Guided Grounding: Elevating Video Anomaly Detection through Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) has traditionally been framed as binary classification or outlier detection, providing neither interpretable reasoning nor precise spatial localization of anomalous events. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer rich scene understanding, they struggle with reliable spatial grounding - often producing hallucinated or geometrically invalid bounding boxes when asked to localize objects. We propose VANGUARD (Video Anomaly Understanding through Reasoning and Grounding), a framework that unifies anomaly classification, spatial grounding, and chain-of-thought reasoning within a single VLM. VANGUARD introduces a three-stage curriculum that progressively layers training objectives: (1) classifier warmup on frozen backbone features, (2) LoRA-adapted spatial grounding, and (3) chain-of-thought generation. To overcome the sparse annotation typical of VAD benchmarks, we employ a teacher-student annotation pipeline in which a VLM (Qwen3-VL-4B) generates structured per-subclip reasoning trajectories based on manual annotations available from the UCA Dataset. Further, GroundingDINO provides bounding box supervision. On UCF-Crime, VANGUARD achieves 94% ROC-AUC with 84% F1 while simultaneously producing interpretable chain-of-thought explanations and spatial grounding of anomalous objects - capabilities absent from prior VAD methods. Ablations confirm that staged training outperforms monolithic optimization, and that structured reasoning acts as an implicit regularizer yielding more balanced predictions than classification-only fine-tuning. Zero-shot transfer to XD-Violence and ShanghaiTech demonstrates cross-domain generalization without target-domain adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出VANGUARD框架，将异常分类、空间定位和思维链推理统一到单一视觉语言模型中，在UCF-Crime上达到94% ROC-AUC和84% F1，同时具备可解释推理和空间定位能力。
AI.motivation: 传统视频异常检测方法仅做二分类或异常检测，缺乏可解释推理和精准的空间定位能力；现有VLM虽场景理解能力强，但空间定位存在幻觉和几何无效边界框问题。
AI.method: 三阶段渐进式课程学习：(1)冻结骨干网络进行分类器预热，(2)LoRA适配的空间定位训练，(3)思维链生成训练。采用教师-学生标注流程，利用Qwen3-VL-4B生成推理轨迹，GroundingDINO提供边界框监督。
AI.result: UCF-Crime上ROC-AUC 94%，F1 84%；消融实验证明分阶段训练优于整体优化，结构化推理起到隐式正则化作用；零样本迁移到XD-Violence和ShanghaiTech展现跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: VANGUARD首次实现了视频异常检测中的异常分类、空间定位与可解释推理的统一，且具备跨域零样本泛化能力，克服了传统方法的局限性。

title: Approaching human parity in the quality of automated organoid image segmentation
summary:
Organoids are complex, three dimensional, self-organizing cell cultures which manifest organ-like features and represent a powerful platform for studying human disease and developing treatment options. Organoid development is characterized by dynamic morphological and cellular organization, which mimic some aspects of organ development. To study these rapid changes over the course of organoid development, advanced imaging and analytical tools are critical to accurately monitor the trajectory of organoid growth and investigate disease processes.
  In this work, we focus on computer vision and machine learning techniques to automatically measure the size and shape of developing spheroids derived from pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), which are typically the starting material for generating organoid cultures. To facilitate this task, we introduce a composite method that combines the Segment Anything Model (SAM), a general-purpose foundation model, with an existing domain-specific tool. This composite method is evaluated together with several existing tools by testing them on organoid image data and comparing with the results of manual image segmentation. We find that no single existing tool is able to segment the test images with sufficient accuracy across all test conditions, but the newly introduced composite method produces consistent and accurate results for all but a very small fraction of the most challenging images. Finally, we compare the accuracy of this method to the variability between manual segmentations by independent annotators (inter-observer variability) and find that by one measure it performs at the level of inter-observer variability and by others it performs very close to it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合通用基础模型（SAM）与领域特定工具的复合方法，用于自动测量iPSC来源的球体（类器官前体）的尺寸和形状，经测试在大多数条件下达到接近人工标注者间变异水平的准确度。
AI.motivation: 类器官发育过程中形态变化快速，需要先进的成像和分析工具来准确监测其生长轨迹并研究疾病过程，而现有工具在自动分割类器官图像时精度不足。
AI.method: 将通用基础模型Segment Anything Model (SAM)与现有的领域特定工具相结合，形成复合方法，并在类器官图像数据上测试，与手动分割结果进行比较。
AI.result: 现有单一工具在所有测试条件下均无法达到足够准确的分割，而新提出的复合方法在除极少数最具挑战性的图像外，均能产生一致且准确的结果，其精度达到或非常接近人工标注者间变异水平。
AI.conclusion: 该复合方法可有效自动化类器官图像分割，为类器官发育研究提供可靠的分析工具。

title: When Should a Language Model Trust Itself? Same-Model Self-Verification as a Conditional Confidence Signal
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables. Code available on GitHub
summary: Same-model self-verification, prompting a model to audit its own predicted answer, is a plausible confidence signal for selective prediction, but its practical value remains unclear once strong likelihood-based baselines are taken seriously. We evaluate self-verification against two such baselines, LL-AVG and LL-SUM, on ARC-Challenge and TruthfulQA-MC across multiple model families, scales, and prompt variants. We measure not only correctness ranking, but also abstention quality through AURC and operating-point analyses. The results are sharply task- and model-dependent. On ARC-Challenge, self-verification substantially improves over LL-AVG for Phi-2 and the Qwen models, with the largest gains appearing in Qwen-7B. On TruthfulQA-MC, however, the signal is less reliable: smaller models can become prompt-sensitive, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-8B degrades relative to LL-AVG, and LL-SUM often remains the stronger practical baseline. We therefore do not treat self-verification as a general-purpose uncertainty estimator. In this setting, it is better understood as a conditional confidence signal whose value depends on task type, model family, prompt formulation, and, crucially, the baseline it must beat.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了同模型自我验证（self-verification）作为选择性预测中置信度信号的有效性，发现其性能高度依赖于任务类型、模型家族、规模、提示变体以及所对比的基线方法（LL-AVG和LL-SUM），并非通用的不确定性估计方法。
AI.motivation: 在选择性预测中，同模型自我验证作为一种置信度信号被提出，但其在实际应用中的价值尚不明确，尤其是在与强基线的对比下。
AI.method: 在ARC-Challenge和TruthfulQA-MC两个基准上，针对多个模型家族、规模和提示变体，将自我验证与LL-AVG和LL-SUM两种基线方法进行对比，使用正确性排序、AURC以及操作点分析来评估弃权质量。
AI.result: 自我验证在ARC-Challenge上对Phi-2和Qwen模型有显著提升（Qwen-7B提升最大），但在TruthfulQA-MC上可靠性较差，小模型对提示敏感，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-8B表现退化，LL-SUM常为更强的基线。
AI.conclusion: 自我验证不应被视为通用的不确定性估计器，而是一种条件性置信度信号，其价值取决于任务类型、模型家族、提示设计以及需要超越的基线方法。

title: CreativityBench: Evaluating Agent Creative Reasoning via Affordance-Based Tool Repurposing
summary: Recent advances in large language models have led to strong performance on reasoning and environment-interaction tasks, yet their ability for creative problem-solving remains underexplored. We study this capability through the lens of creative tool use, where a model repurposes available objects by reasoning about their affordances and attributes rather than relying on canonical usage. As a first step, we introduce CreativityBench, a benchmark for evaluating affordance-based creativity in LLMs. To this end, we build a large-scale affordance knowledge base (KB) with 4K entities and 150K+ affordance annotations, explicitly linking objects, parts, attributes, and actionable uses. Building on this KB, we generate 14K grounded tasks that require identifying non-obvious yet physically plausible solutions under constraints. Evaluations across 10 state-of-the-art LLMs, including closed and open-source models, show that models can often select a plausible object, but fail to identify the correct parts, their affordances, and the underlying physical mechanism needed to solve the task, leading to a significant drop in performance. Furthermore, improvements from model scaling quickly saturate, strong general reasoning does not reliably translate to creative affordance discovery, and common inference-time strategies such as Chain-of-Thought yield limited gains. These results suggest that creative tool use remains a major challenge for current models, and that CreativityBench provides a useful testbed for studying this missing dimension of intelligence, with potential implications for planning and reasoning modules in future agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CreativityBench基准，通过大规模知识库和14K个创造性工具使用任务，评估大语言模型基于功能属性的创造性问题解决能力。实验表明，现有模型虽能选择合理对象，但在识别正确部件、功能及物理机制上表现不佳，且模型扩展、推理策略提升有限，说明创造性工具使用仍是当前AI的重大挑战。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在推理和交互任务上表现强劲，但其创造性问题解决能力尚未被充分探索，因此需要系统评估模型在创造性工具使用方面的能力。
AI.method: 构建包含4K实体和15万+功能注释的大规模功能知识库，并基于此生成14K个需要识别非显而易见但物理可行的解决方案的地面任务，形成CreativityBench基准。
AI.result: 模型能选择合理对象，但识别正确部件、功能及物理机制时性能显著下降；模型扩展收益迅速饱和；强推理能力不保证创造性功能发现；CoT等推理策略提升有限。
AI.conclusion: 创造性工具使用仍是当前模型的主要挑战，CreativityBench为研究这一缺失的智能维度提供了有价值的测试平台。

title: Evaluating Reasoning Models for Queries with Presuppositions
summary: Millions of users turn to AI models for their information needs. It is conceivable that a large number of user queries contain assumptions that may be factually inaccurate. Prior work notes that large language models (LLMs) often fail to challenge such erroneous assumptions, and can reinforce users' misinformed opinions. However, given the recent advances, especially in model's reasoning capabilities, we revisit whether large reasoning models (LRMs) can reason about the underlying assumptions and respond to user queries appropriately. We construct queries with varying degrees of presuppositions spanning health, science, and general knowledge, and use it to evaluate several widely-deployed models When compared to non-reasoning models, we find that reasoning models achieve a slightly higher accuracy (2-11%), but they still fail to challenge a large fraction (26-42%) of false presuppositions. Further, reasoning models remain susceptible to how strongly the presupposition is expressed.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，即使是大推理模型（LRMs）也未能有效挑战用户查询中的错误预设，在健康、科学和通识领域仍存在26-42%的失败率，相比非推理模型仅提升2-11%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 大量用户查询包含事实不准确的预设，而先前研究指出LLMs通常无法质疑这些错误假设，可能强化用户的错误认知。随着模型推理能力的进步，作者希望重新评估新一代推理模型能否更好地处理这类问题。
AI.method: 构建了涵盖健康、科学和通识知识领域、具有不同程度预设的查询数据集，对比评估多个广泛部署的推理模型与非推理模型的应答表现。
AI.result: 推理模型准确率仅比非推理模型高2-11%，但仍无法挑战26-42%的错误预设，且性能受预设表达强度的影响。
AI.conclusion: 当前推理模型在识别和质疑错误预设方面虽有微小进步，但能力仍十分有限，尚不能可靠地帮助用户纠正错误认知。

title: Stable Agentic Control: Tool-Mediated LLM Architecture for Autonomous Cyber Defense
comment: 23 pages total (9 main paper + 16 appendices/references), 2 figures
summary: Agentic systems involved in high-stake decision-making under adversarial pressure need formal guarantees not offered by existing approaches. Motivated by the operational needs of security operations centers (SOCs) that must configure endpoint detection and response (EDR) policies under adversarial pressure, we present a tool-mediated architecture: LLM agents use deterministic tools (Stackelberg best-response, Bayesian observer updates, attack-graph primitives) and select from finite action catalogs enforced at the tool-output interface. A composite Lyapunov function machine-checked in Lean 4 with zero sorry certifies controllability, observability from asymmetric sensor data, and Input-to-State Stability (ISS) robustness under intelligent adversarial disturbance, with two corollaries extending the certificate to any controller or adversary from the catalogs. On 282 real enterprise attack graphs, the claims hold with margin. On paired offensive/defensive telemetry, a tool-mediated Claude Sonnet 4 controller reduces the attacker's expected payoff (game value) by 59% relative to a deterministic greedy baseline, with zero variance across 40 runs at four temperatures. A Claude Haiku 4.5 controller converges to suboptimal game values but stays catalog-bounded over an additional 40 runs, demonstrating that architectural stability is not dependent on the controller capability. The LLM agent's non-determinism furthers creative exploration of strategies, while the tool-mediated architecture ensures system stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种工具中介的LLM智能体架构，通过Lean 4形式化验证确保在高风险对抗决策中的系统稳定性，在282个真实企业攻击图上验证了有效性，并使攻击者期望收益降低59%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法无法为高风险、对抗压力下的智能体系统提供形式化保证，而安全运营中心（SOC）在配置端点检测与响应（EDR）策略时迫切需要这类保障。
AI.method: 提出工具中介架构：LLM智能体使用确定性工具（Stackelberg最优响应、贝叶斯观测更新、攻击图原语），从有限动作目录中选择；使用Lean 4构建复合李雅普诺夫函数（零sorry）验证可控性、可观性和输入-状态稳定性（ISS）。
AI.result: 在282个真实企业攻击图上所有声明均成立；工具中介的Claude Sonnet 4控制器相比确定性贪心基线降低攻击者期望收益59%，40次运行零方差；Claude Haiku 4.5虽收敛到次优值但仍保持目录有界性。
AI.conclusion: 非确定性LLM智能体可促进策略创造性探索，同时工具中介架构保障系统稳定性，且稳定性不依赖于控制器能力水平。

title: How Language Models Process Negation
comment: ICML2026 preprint, camera ready in progress
summary: We study how Large Language Models (LLMs) process negation mechanistically. First, we establish that even though open-weight models often provide wrong answers to questions involving negation, they do possess internal components that process negation correctly. Their poor accuracy is due to late-layer attention behavior that promotes simple shortcuts; ablating those attention modules greatly improves accuracy on negation-related questions. Second, we uncover how models process negation. We consider two hypotheses: models could use attention heads that attend to the phrase being negated and suppress related concepts, or they could directly construct a representation of the entire negative phrase (e.g., representing "not gas" as a vector that promotes liquids and solids). We apply a range of observational and causal interpretability techniques on Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B to show that models implement both mechanisms, with the "constructive" mechanism being more prominent. Combined, our work deepens the understanding of LLMs' internals, highlighting construction-dominant computations and the coexistence of competing mechanisms within LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM处理否定的机制，发现模型内部存在正确处理否定的组件，但后期注意力层会促进简单捷径导致错误；同时揭示了模型通过“抑制”和“构建”两种机制处理否定，其中构建机制更为突出。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在处理包含否定的问题时内部工作机制，解释为何模型在否定问题上准确率低但内部却具备正确处理否定的能力。
AI.method: 采用观察性和因果性可解释性技术，在Mistral-7B和Llama-3.1-8B模型上进行实验，包括ablating注意力模块、分析注意力头行为等。
AI.result: 模型内部存在正确处理否定的组件；后期注意力层会促进简单捷径导致错误答案，ablating这些模块能显著提升准确率；模型同时使用“抑制机制”（关注被否定短语并抑制相关概念）和“构建机制”（直接构建否定短语的向量表示），后者更为突出。
AI.conclusion: 加深了对LLM内部机制的理解，揭示了构建主导的计算以及LLM内部存在竞争性机制共存的现象。

title: Computing Thiele Rules on Interval Elections and their Generalizations
summary:
Approval-based committee voting has received significant attention in the social choice community. Among the studied rules, Thiele rules, and especially Proportional Approval Voting (PAV), stand out for desirable properties such as proportional representation, Pareto optimality, and support monotonicity. Their main drawback is that computing a Thiele outcome is NP-hard in general.
  A glimpse of hope comes from the fact that Thiele rules are better behaved under structured preferences. On the candidate interval (CI) domain, they are computable in polynomial time via a linear program (LP) that has a totally unimodular constraint matrix. Surprisingly, this approach fails for the related voter interval (VI) domain, and the complexity of the problem has repeatedly been posed as an open question. Our main result resolves this question: although the relevant matrix is not totally unimodular, the ``standard'' LP still admits at least one optimal integral solution, and we provide a fast algorithm for finding it.
  Our technique naturally extends to the voter-candidate interval (VCI) domain, also known as the 1-dimensional voter-candidate range (1D-VCR) domain, and to the linearly consistent (LC) domain, both of which generalize the candidate and voter interval domains. Although both the VCI and LC domains have been studied in social choice, their relationship was unknown. We show, through connections to graph theory, that LC strictly contains VCI. We also provide an alternative definition of LC that is closer in spirit to VCI and has a natural interpretation in approval elections; this equivalence may be of independent interest. Finally, we study an alternative tree-based generalization of VCI and show that Thiele rules become NP-hard to compute on this domain.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于批准的委员会投票中的Thiele规则，发现在候选人区间（CI）域上可多项式时间求解，但在选民区间（VI）域上的复杂度是开放问题。作者解决了该问题：标准线性规划仍存在最优整数解，并给出了快速算法。该方法还扩展到选民-候选人区间（VCI）域和线性一致（LC）域，并揭示了LC严格包含VCI的关系。最后，研究表明在基于树的推广域上Thiele规则是NP-hard的。
AI.motivation: Thiele规则（特别是PAV）具有良好的比例代表性、帕累托最优性和支持单调性，但计算其结果是NP-hard的。此前已知在候选人区间域上可多项式求解，但选民区间域上的复杂度是长期未解决的开放问题，本文旨在解决该问题。
AI.method: 通过分析标准线性规划（LP）的约束矩阵性质，证明即使在选民区间域上矩阵并非全幺模，但LP仍然至少有一个最优整数解，并设计了快速求解算法。该方法自然扩展到VCI和LC域，并通过图论建立了两者的包含关系。
AI.result: 1) 解决了选民区间域上Thiele规则计算复杂度的开放问题；2) 证明标准LP在VI域上仍存在最优整数解，给出快速算法；3) 证明了LC域严格包含VCI域；4) 在基于树的推广域上证明了Thiele规则是NP-hard的。
AI.conclusion: Thiele规则在结构化的偏好域上具有可计算性，但在更一般的树状推广域上仍然难以求解。VCI和LC域的关系得到澄清，LC的替代定义可能具有独立意义。

title: Boundary-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for Wildfire Spread Prediction
summary: Reliable wildfire spread prediction is vital for risk-aware emergency planning, yet most deep learning models lack principled uncertainty quantification (UQ). Further, for boundary-sensitive cases like wildfire spread, evaluating models with global metrics alone is often insufficient. To shift the focus of UQ evaluation toward a more operationally relevant approach, the Fire-Centered Evaluation Region (FCER) framework is introduced as a spatially conditioned protocol to characterize UQ within critical fire zones. Using FCER, an Ensemble is compared against an distilled single-pass student model on the WildfireSpreadTS dataset. The student model demonstrates comparable calibration and complementary uncertainty ranking in boundary-relevant regimes. Code is available at https://github. com/jonasvilhofunk/WildfireUQ-FCER

AI.tldr: 本文提出火中心评估区域（FCER）框架，用于对野火蔓延预测中的不确定性量化（UQ）进行空间条件化评估，并对比了集成模型与蒸馏单次学生模型的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型缺乏原理性的不确定性量化，且全局指标对边界敏感型野火蔓延场景评估不足，需要更贴近实际运营的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出火中心评估区域（FCER）框架，作为空间条件化协议，在关键火灾区域内表征UQ；在WildfireSpreadTS数据集上比较集成模型与蒸馏单次学生模型。
AI.result: 学生模型在校准性上表现相当，并在边界相关区域提供互补的不确定性排序。
AI.conclusion: FCER框架可以将UQ评估的焦点转向更具操作相关性的方式，且蒸馏模型在边界场景下具有实用价值。

title: Making the Invisible Visible: Understanding the Mismatch Between Organizational Goals and Worker Experiences in AI Adoption
summary: While AI is often introduced into organizations to drive innovation and efficiency, many adoption efforts fail as workers resist and struggle to integrate these systems. These failures point to a deeper issue: workers, the very people expected to collaborate with AI, are often invisible in decisions about how AI is designed and used. Drawing on interviews with professionals who interact with AI systems daily in healthcare, finance, and management, we examine the disconnect between organizational expectations and worker experiences. We identify key barriers, including poor usability and interoperability, misaligned expectations, limited control, and insufficient communication. These challenges highlight a gap between how organizations implement AI and the evolving worker needs, tasks, and workflows that it fails to support. We argue that successful adoption requires recognizing workers as central to AI integration and propose adaptation strategies at the individual, task, and organizational levels to better align AI systems with real-world practices.

AI.tldr: 本文通过访谈医疗、金融和管理领域的专业人士，揭示AI采纳失败的核心原因：工人在AI设计与使用决策中被忽视。识别出可用性差、期望错位、控制权有限和沟通不足等障碍，并提出在个人、任务和组织层面进行适应调整的策略。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI被引入组织以推动创新和效率，但许多采纳努力因工人抵抗和难以整合而失败。研究者意识到工人——这些本应与AI协作的关键角色——在AI设计和使用的决策过程中常常被忽视，因此希望探究这种脱节背后的深层原因。
AI.method: 对医疗、金融和管理领域日常与AI系统交互的专业人士进行访谈，分析组织期望与工人实际体验之间的脱节。
AI.result: 识别出关键障碍：可用性和互操作性差、期望错位、控制权有限、沟通不足。这些挑战反映了组织AI实施方式与不断变化的工人需求、任务和工作流程之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 成功的AI采纳需要认识到工人在AI整合中的核心地位，并提出在个人、任务和组织三个层面的适应策略，以更好地使AI系统与现实实践对齐。

title: Programmatic Context Augmentation for LLM-based Symbolic Regression
summary: Symbolic regression (SR), the task of discovering mathematical expressions that best describe a given dataset, remains a fundamental challenge in scientific discovery. Traditional approaches, primarily based on genetic algorithms and related evolutionary methods, have proven useful but suffer from scalability and expressivity limitations. Recently, large language model (LLM)-based evolutionary search methods have been introduced into SR and show promise. However, existing LLM-based approaches typically rely on scalar evaluation metrics, such as mean squared error, as the sole source of feedback during the search process, thereby overlooking the rich information embedded in the dataset. To address this limitation, we propose a novel LLM-based evolutionary search framework that incorporates programmatic context augmentation. By enabling code-based interactions with the dataset, our method can actively perform data analysis and extract informative signals, beyond aggregated evaluation scores. We evaluate our framework on advanced benchmarks, such as LLM-SRBench, and demonstrate superior efficiency and accuracy compared to strong baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于大语言模型的进化搜索框架，通过程序化上下文增强让模型能够主动分析数据集，从而超越传统标量评估指标，在符号回归任务中取得更优效果。
AI.motivation: 传统符号回归方法（如遗传算法）可扩展性和表达力有限；现有LLM进化搜索方法仅依赖标量评估指标（如均方误差），忽略了数据集中丰富的潜在信息。
AI.method: 提出一种基于LLM的进化搜索框架，引入程序化上下文增强机制，使模型能够通过代码与数据集交互，主动进行数据分析和提取信息信号。
AI.result: 在LLM-SRBench等高级基准测试上，相比强基线方法，展现了更优的效率和准确性。
AI.conclusion: 程序化上下文增强使LLM能够超越聚合评估分数，利用数据集中的丰富信息，有效提升符号回归的性能。

title: Sentinel2Cap: A Human-Annotated Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Captioning
summary: Image captioning has become an important task in computer vision, enabling models to generate natural language descriptions of visual content. While several datasets exist for natural images and high-resolution optical remote sensing imagery, the availability of captioning datasets for multimodal satellite data remains limited, particularly for SAR imagery and medium-resolution sensors. We introduce Sentinel2Cap, a human-annotated multimodal captioning dataset containing Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multi-spectral image patches at 10 m and 20 m spatial resolution with diverse land cover compositions. Captions are created manually and carefully validated to ensure both semantic accuracy and linguistic quality. To evaluate Sentinel2Cap, we perform a zero-shot captioning using the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct model across three image modalities: RGB, multi-spectral, and SAR pseudo-RGB representations. Results show that RGB images achieve the highest captioning performance, while SAR images remain more challenging for vision-language models. Providing modality-specific contextual prompts consistently improves performance across all metrics. These findings highlight both the challenges of multimodal remote sensing image captioning and the potential value of human-annotated datasets for advancing research in cross-modal scene understanding. All the material is publicly avaiable.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Sentinel2Cap，一个为多模态卫星数据（Sentinel-1 SAR和Sentinel-2多光谱影像）构建的人工标注描述数据集，并通过Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型进行零样本描述生成实验，发现RGB图像效果最好，SAR图像最具挑战性，模态提示能提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图像描述数据集多针对自然图像或高分辨率光学遥感图像，缺乏面向多模态卫星数据（尤其是SAR影像和中分辨率传感器）的描述数据集，限制了跨模态场景理解的研究。
AI.method: 构建Sentinel2Cap人工标注多模态描述数据集；使用Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型在RGB、多光谱、SAR伪RGB三种模态下进行零样本描述生成；引入模态特定的上下文提示。
AI.result: RGB图像描述性能最高，SAR图像对视觉-语言模型最具挑战性；提供模态特定提示能一致提升所有指标的性能。
AI.conclusion: 多模态遥感图像描述仍面临挑战，人工标注数据集对推动跨模态场景理解研究具有重要价值；所有数据已公开。

title: Are you with me? A Framework for Detecting Mental Model Discrepancies in Task-Based Team Dialogues
comment: Accepted to Proceedings of the Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Science Society 2026
summary: Humans typically use natural language to update teammates on task states. Since not all updates are communicated, discrepancies arise between the team members' mental models that negatively affect overall team performance. How can we categorize such discrepancies? Do misalignments detected in team dialogue predict future mental model misalignments? Traditional shared mental model (SMM) assessment methods rely on retrospective expert coding that cannot capture real-time coordination dynamics. We propose a framework to identify and categorize four types of mental model discrepancies: unsupported beliefs, false beliefs, belief contradictions, and omissions, all of which can naturally emerge in team dialogues. Using dialogues from twenty dyad teams performing collaborative object identification tasks across four sequential levels, we demonstrate that these discrepancy patterns contain predictive signals. Averaging historical discrepancy counts achieves meaningful prediction accuracy using uniform weighting as an exploratory baseline, with differential predictability across discrepancy types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个框架，用于识别和分类团队对话中出现的四种心智模型差异（无依据信念、错误信念、信念矛盾、遗漏），并通过实验证明这些差异模式具有预测信号，能预测未来心智模型的失调。
AI.motivation: 传统的心智模型评估方法依赖回顾性专家编码，无法捕捉实时的协调动态。人类在团队协作中通常用自然语言更新任务状态，但并非所有更新都会被传达，导致团队成员心智模型之间出现差异，影响团队绩效。因此需要一种能实时识别和分类这些差异的方法。
AI.method: 提出一个框架，识别和分类四种心智模型差异类型：无依据信念、错误信念、信念矛盾、遗漏。在20个双人团队执行四层协作目标识别任务的对话数据上进行实验，使用历史差异计数的均匀加权作为探索性基线，评估预测准确性。
AI.result: 这些差异模式包含预测信号。使用历史差异计数的均匀加权方法达到了有意义的预测准确性，且不同差异类型的可预测性存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够实时捕捉团队对话中的心智模型差异，并有效预测未来的心智模型失调，为团队协作的动态监控提供了新的方法支持。

title: Effective Performance Measurement: Challenges and Opportunities in KPI Extraction from Earnings Calls
summary: Earnings calls are a key source of financial information about public companies. However, extracting information from these calls is difficult. Unlike the templatic filings required by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to report a company's financial situation, earnings conference calls have no built-in labels, are unstructured, and feature conversational language. We explore this challenging domain by assessing the information captured by models trained on SEC filings and in-context learning methods. To establish a baseline, we first evaluate the generalization capabilities of SEC-trained models across established SEC datasets. To support our investigation, we introduce three novel benchmarks: (1) SEC Filings Benchmark (SECB), (2) Earnings Calls Benchmark (ECB), and ECB-A, a subset with 2,460 expert annotation groups to support our qualitative analysis. We find that encoder-based models struggle with the domain shift. Finally, we propose a system utilizing LLMs to perform open-ended extraction from unstructured call transcripts, verified by human evaluation (79.7% precision), providing a baseline for this valuable domain through the consistent tracking of emergent KPIs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了从非结构化、无标签的财报电话会议中提取财务信息的挑战，提出使用SEC报表训练模型和LLM上下文学习方法，并引入三个新基准（SECB、ECB、ECB-A），最终提出基于LLM的开放式信息提取系统，人工评估精确率达79.7%。
AI.motivation: 财报电话会议是上市公司关键信息来源，但其非结构化、无标签、口语化的特点使得信息提取非常困难，现有模型难以应对这种领域迁移。
AI.method: 评估SEC训练模型在SEC数据集上的泛化能力；引入三个新基准（SECB、ECB、ECB-A，其中ECB-A包含2,460个专家标注组）；提出利用LLM从非结构化会议记录中进行开放式提取的系统。
AI.result: 编码器模型在领域迁移中表现不佳；提出的LLM系统在人工评估中达到79.7%的精确率。
AI.conclusion: LLM系统为从财报电话会议中提取新兴KPI提供了有效基线方法，该领域具有重要应用价值。

title: Learning Correct Behavior from Examples: Validating Sequential Execution in Autonomous Agents
summary: As autonomous agents become increasingly sophisticated, validating their sequential behavior presents a significant challenge. Traditional testing approaches require manual specification, exact sequence matching, or thousands of training examples. We present a novel algorithm that automatically learns correct behavior from just 2-10 passing execution traces and validates new executions against this learned model. Our approach combines dominator analysis from compiler theory with multimodal large language model-powered semantic understanding to identify essential states and handle non-deterministic behavior. The system constructs a generalized ground truth model using Prefix Tree Acceptors, merges traces through multi-tiered equivalence detection, and validates new executions via topological subsequence matching. In controlled experiments, our system achieved high accuracy in detecting product bugs and false successes using only 3 training traces. This approach provides explainable validation results with coverage metrics and works across diverse domains including UI testing, code generation, and robotic processes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种新算法，仅需2-10条成功执行轨迹即可自动学习智能体的正确行为，并通过拓扑子序列匹配进行验证。
AI.motivation: 传统方法需要人工标注、精确序列匹配或大量训练样本，无法高效验证日益复杂的自主智能体行为。
AI.method: 结合编译器理论的支配者分析与多模态大语言模型的语义理解，使用前缀树接受器构建通用模型，通过多层等价检测合并轨迹，再基于拓扑子序列匹配进行验证。
AI.result: 仅用3条训练轨迹即可高精度检测产品缺陷与假阳性成功，并提供可解释的验证结果与覆盖率指标。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在UI测试、代码生成和机器人流程等多个领域均有效，为智能体行为验证提供了一种低样本、高精度的通用方案。

title: CropVLM: A Domain-Adapted Vision-Language Model for Open-Set Crop Analysis
summary: High-throughput plant phenotyping, the quantitative measurement of observable plant traits, is critical for modern breeding but remains constrained by a "phenotyping bottleneck," where manual data collection is labor-intensive and prone to observer bias. Conventional closed-set computer vision systems fail to address this challenge, as they require extensive species-specific annotation and lack the flexibility to handle diverse breeding populations. To bridge this gap, we present CropVLM, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) adapted for the agricultural domain via Domain-Specific Semantic Alignment (DSSA). Trained on 52,987 manually selected image-caption pairs covering 37 species in natural field conditions, CropVLM effectively maps agronomic terminology to fine-grained visual features. We further introduce the Hybrid Open-Set Localization Network (HOS-Net), an architecture that integrates CropVLM to enable the detection of novel crops solely from natural language descriptions without retraining. By eliminating the reliance on species-specific training data, CropVLM provides a scalable solution for high-throughput phenotyping, accelerating genetic gain and facilitating large-scale biodiversity research essential for sustainable agriculture. The trained model weights and complete pipeline implementation are publicly available at: [https://github.com/boudiafA/CropVLM](https://github.com/boudiafA/CropVLM). In comprehensive evaluations, CropVLM achieves 72.51% zero-shot classification accuracy, outperforming seven CLIP-style baselines. Our detection pipeline demonstrates superior zero-shot generalization to novel species, achieving 49.17 AP50 on our CVTCropDet benchmark and 50.73 AP50 on tropical fruit species, compared to 34.89 and 48.58 for the next-best method, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CropVLM，一种针对农业领域适配的视觉-语言模型，通过域特定语义对齐（DSSA）和混合开放集定位网络（HOS-Net），实现了对37种作物在自然田间条件下的零样本分类和检测，显著缓解了植物表型分析中的“表型瓶颈”问题。
AI.motivation: 传统高通量植物表型分析受限于“表型瓶颈”——人工数据收集耗时且存在观察者偏差，而传统的闭集计算机视觉系统需要大量物种特定标注，缺乏处理多样化育种群体的灵活性。
AI.method: CropVLM通过域特定语义对齐（DSSA）在52,987个手动筛选的图像-文本对（覆盖37个物种）上进行训练；并提出混合开放集定位网络（HOS-Net），集成CropVLM实现仅凭自然语言描述即可检测新作物，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 零样本分类准确率72.51%，超越七种CLIP基线；检测任务中在CVTCropDet基准上达到49.17 AP50，热带水果物种上达到50.73 AP50，均优于次优方法（34.89和48.58）。
AI.conclusion: CropVLM通过消除对物种特定训练数据的依赖，为高通量表型分析提供了可扩展的解决方案，有助于加速遗传增益和大规模生物多样性研究，推动可持续农业发展。

title: Geometric Deviation as an Unsupervised Pre-Generation Reliability Signal: Probing LLM Representations for Answerability
comment: Accepted to TrustNLP 2026 (ACL Workshop). 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables
summary:
A reliable language model should be able to signal, prior to generation, when a query falls outside its knowledge. We investigate whether representation geometry can provide such a pre-generation signal by measuring the deviation of hidden states from an answerable reference set, requiring no labeled failure data and no access to model outputs.
  Across three instruction-tuned models (Llama 3.1-8B, Qwen 2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B-Instruct) and three prompt forms (Math, Fact, Code), we find that geometry primarily encodes task form. Within mathematical prompts, unanswerable inputs consistently deviate from the answerable centroid, yielding strong separation (ROC-AUC 0.78-0.84). This single-pass pre-generation signal outperforms a simple refusal baseline and compares favorably to self-consistency. It also captures cases where models do not explicitly refuse.
  In contrast, no reliable geometric signal emerges for factual prompts, indicating that the effect is form-conditional rather than universal. Code prompts show large effect sizes with higher variance, suggesting partial generalization beyond mathematical form.
  A layer-wise analysis reveals that the signal arises in early layers and gradually attenuates toward the output. These results suggest that answerability-related geometry is established before the final stages of generation. Together, these findings indicate that geometric deviation can serve as a lightweight pre-generation signal that is reliable in structured domains with formal answerability constraints, with clear boundaries on where it generalizes.

AI.tldr: 在指令微调模型中，通过分析隐藏状态与可回答参考集的几何偏差，可以在生成前有效检测数学问题是否超出模型知识范围（ROC-AUC 0.78-0.84），但对事实性问题的检测效果不佳，说明该信号具有任务形式依赖性。
AI.motivation: 让语言模型在生成内容之前就能主动识别出超出其知识范围的问题，避免产生不可靠的回答。
AI.method: 通过测量隐藏状态与可回答参考集之间的几何偏差来生成预生成信号，无需标注失败数据或访问模型输出。在三种指令微调模型和三种提示形式（数学、事实、代码）上进行实验。
AI.result: 在数学提示中，不可回答输入与可回答质心显著偏离（ROC-AUC 0.78-0.84），优于简单拒绝基线和自一致性方法；事实提示中无可靠几何信号；代码提示中效果较大但方差更高；该信号在浅层出现并逐渐衰减。
AI.conclusion: 几何偏差可作为轻量级预生成信号，在具有形式化可回答性约束的结构化领域中可靠，但存在明确的泛化边界。

title: Terminus-4B: Can a Smaller Model Replace Frontier LLMs at Agentic Execution Tasks?
summary: Modern coding agents increasingly delegate specialized subtasks to subagents, which are smaller, focused agentic loops that handle narrow responsibilities like search, debugging or terminal execution. This architectural pattern keeps the main agent's context window clean by isolating verbose outputs (e.g. build logs, test results, etc.) within the subagent context. Typically when agents employ subagents for such tasks, they use frontier models as these subagents. In this paper, we investigate whether a finetuned small language model (SLM) can achieve comparable performance to frontier models in the task of agentic terminal execution. We present Terminus-4B, which is a post-trained Qwen3-4B model via Supervised Finetuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) using rubric-based LLM-as-judge reward, specifically for this task. In our extensive evaluation spanning various frontier models, training ablations and main agent configurations, we find that Terminus-4B is able to reduce the token usage of the main agent by up to ~30% compared to the No Subagent baseline with no impact to agent performance on benchmarks like SWE-Bench Pro and our internal SWE-Bench C# benchmark, which tends to be heavy in verbose execution tasks. Furthermore, Terminus-4B improves key metrics showing the main agent relying on the outputs of the subagent and doing fewer terminal execution tasks by itself. We see that our model not only closes the gap between the Vanilla Qwen model and frontier models like Claude Sonnet / Opus / GPT-5.3-Codex, but often even exceeds their performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Terminus-4B，一个通过SFT和RL训练的4B参数小语言模型，用于代理终端执行任务。该模型作为代码代理的子代理，能在不影响基准性能的情况下，将主代理的token使用量减少约30%，并在多项指标上超越或媲美Claude Sonnet/Opus/GPT-5.3-Codex等前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 现代编码代理通常将专业子任务委派给子代理，但当前通常使用前沿模型作为子代理，成本高昂。作者希望探究微调的小语言模型（SLM）是否能在终端执行任务中达到与前沿模型相当的性能，从而降低计算成本和token消耗。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3-4B模型，通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）进行后训练，其中RL采用基于评分标准的LLM-as-judge奖励机制，专门针对代理终端执行任务进行优化。
AI.result: Terminus-4B可使主代理token使用量减少约30%，且不影响SWE-Bench Pro和内部SWE-Bench C#基准测试的性能。在关键指标上，不仅缩小了原始Qwen模型与前沿模型的差距，还经常超越Claude Sonnet/Opus/GPT-5.3-Codex等模型。
AI.conclusion: 微调的小语言模型在代理终端执行任务中可以替代前沿模型作为子代理，既能保持甚至提升性能，又能显著降低token消耗，是一种高效且经济的方案。

title: VEBench:Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Real-World Video Editing
summary: Real-world video editing demands not only expert knowledge of cinematic techniques but also multimodal reasoning to select, align, and combine footage into coherent narratives. While recent Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have shown remarkable progress in general video understanding, their abilities in multi-video reasoning and operational editing workflows remain largely unexplored. We introduce VEBENCH, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate both editing knowledge understanding and operational reasoning in realistic video editing scenarios. VEBENCH contains 3.9K high-quality edited videos (over 257 hours) and 3,080 human-verified QA pairs, built through a three-round human-AI collaborative annotation pipeline that ensures precise temporal labeling and semantic consistency. It features two complementary QA tasks: 1) Video Editing Technique Recognition, assessing models' ability to identify 7 editing techniques using multimodal cues; and 2) Video Editing Operation Simulation, modeling real-world editing workflows by requiring the selection and temporal localization of relevant clips from multiple candidates. Extensive experiments across proprietary (e.g., Gemini-2.5-Pro) and open-source LMMs reveal a large gap between current model performance and human-level editing cognition. These results highlight the urgent need for bridging video understanding with creative operational reasoning. We envision VEBENCH as a foundation for advancing intelligent video editing systems and driving future research on complex reasoning.

AI.tldr: VEBENCH是首个评估多模态大模型在视频编辑理解和操作推理能力的综合基准，包含3.9K高质量编辑视频和3,080个QA对，实验表明当前模型与人类水平存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有LMMs在通用视频理解上表现优异，但在多视频推理和实际编辑操作流程中的能力尚未被系统评估，缺乏针对视频编辑领域专业知识和操作推理的基准测试。
AI.method: 通过三轮人机协作标注流程构建了包含3.9K编辑视频和3,080个QA对的VEBENCH基准，设计了两个互补任务：1) 视频编辑技术识别（7种技术）；2) 视频编辑操作模拟（从多个候选中选择和定位相关片段）。
AI.result: 在多个闭源（如Gemini-2.5-Pro）和开源LMMs上的实验显示，当前模型性能与人类水平的编辑认知存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: VEBENCH揭示了视频理解与创造性操作推理之间的鸿沟，可作为推动智能视频编辑系统发展的基础，并促进复杂推理领域的未来研究。

title: Stop Automating Peer Review Without Rigorous Evaluation
summary: Large language models offer a tempting solution to address the peer review crisis. This position paper argues that today's AI systems should not be used to produce paper reviews. We ground this position in an empirical comparison of human- versus AI-generated ICLR 2026 reviews and an evaluation of the effect of automated paper rewriting on different AI reviewers. We identify two critical issues: 1) AI reviewers exhibit a hivemind effect of excessive agreement within and across papers that reduces perspective diversity. 2) AI review scores are trivially gameable through paper laundering: prompting an LLM to rewrite a paper could significantly increase the scores from AI reviewers, demonstrating that LLM reviewers are easy to game through stylistic changes rather than scientific results. However, non-gameability and review diversity are necessary but not sufficient conditions for automation. We argue that addressing the peer review crisis requires a science of peer review automation -- not general-purpose LLMs deployed without rigorous evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实证比较人类与AI生成的ICLR 2026评审，论证了不应使用当前AI系统生成论文评审，原因包括AI评审存在蜂群效应（过度一致）和可被论文洗白（通过风格改写轻松操纵评分）两大问题。
AI.motivation: 解决同行评审危机，但质疑直接用大语言模型替代人工评审的可行性。
AI.method: 实证比较人类评审与AI生成的ICLR 2026评审，并评估自动论文重写对AI评审的影响。
AI.result: AI评审存在两个关键问题：1) 蜂群效应——评审间和论文间过度一致，降低观点多样性；2) 论文洗白——通过提示LLM改写论文可显著提升AI评审分数，说明AI评审易被风格变化而非科学结果操纵。
AI.conclusion: 不应使用当前通用LLM进行论文评审；解决评审危机需要发展评审自动化的科学，而非未经严格评估的通用AI系统。

title: S^2tory: Story Spine Distillation for Movie Script Summarization
summary: Movie scripts pose a fundamental challenge for automatic summarization due to their non-linear, cross-cut narrative structure, which makes surface-level saliency methods ineffective at preserving core story progression. To address this, we introduce S^2tory (Story Spine Distillation), a narratology-grounded framework that leverages character development trajectories to identify plot nuclei, the essential events that drive the narrative forward, while filtering out peripheral satellite events that merely enrich atmosphere or emotion. Our Narrative Expert Agent (NEAgent) performs theory-constrained reasoning, whose distilled knowledge conditions a small model to identify plot nuclei. Another model then uses these plot nuclei to generate the summary. Experiments on the MovieSum dataset demonstrate state-of-the-art semantic fidelity at approximately 3.5x compression, and zero-shot evaluation on BookSum confirms strong out-of-domain generalization. Human evaluation further validates that narratological theory provides an indispensable foundation for modeling complex, non-linear narratives.

AI.tldr: 提出S^2tory框架，通过角色发展轨迹提取剧情核心事件，在MovieSum和BookSum数据集上实现SOTA摘要性能。
AI.motivation: 电影剧本的非线性交叉叙事结构使传统摘要方法难以保留核心故事进展。
AI.method: 提出叙事学驱动的S^2tory框架，包含Narrative Expert Agent进行理论约束推理，通过知识蒸馏指导小模型识别剧情核心事件，再由另一模型生成摘要。
AI.result: 在MovieSum数据集上实现约3.5倍压缩下的SOTA语义保真度，零样本评估在BookSum上验证了强跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 叙事学理论为建模复杂非线性叙事提供了不可或缺的基础。

title: TACO: Trajectory Aligning Cross-view Optimisation
summary: Cross-View Geo-localisation (CVGL) matches ground imagery against satellite tiles to give absolute position fixes, an alternative to GNSS where signals are occluded, jammed, or spoofed. Recent fine-grained CVGL methods regress sub-tile metric pose, but have only been evaluated as one-shot localisers, never as the primary fix in a live pipeline. Inertial sensing provides high-rate relative motion, but accumulates unbounded drift without an absolute anchor. We propose TACO, a tightly-coupled IMU + fine-grained CVGL pipeline that consumes a single GNSS reading at start-up and thereafter operates on onboard sensing alone. A closed-form cross-track error model triggers CVGL before IMU drift exceeds the matcher's capture radius, and a forward-biased five-point multi-crop search keeps inference cost fixed at five forward passes per fix. A yaw-residual gate rejects fixes that disagree with the onboard compass, and an anisotropic body-frame noise model scales each Unscented Kalman Filter update by per-fix confidence. A factor graph with vetted loop closures provides an offline smoothed trajectory. On the KITTI raw dataset, TACO reduces median Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) from 97.0m (IMU-only) to 16.3m, a 5.9 times reduction, at <0.1 ms per-frame fusion cost and a 5-10% camera duty cycle. Code is available: github.com/tavisshore/TACO.

AI.tldr: TACO将惯性测量单元与细粒度跨视角地理定位紧密耦合，仅需启动时一次GNSS读数，即可实现无GNSS环境下的持续定位，将中位绝对轨迹误差从97.0米降至16.3米。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度CVGL方法仅作为单次定位器评估，从未在实时管道中作为主要定位手段；惯性传感提供高频相对运动但存在漂移，缺乏绝对锚点。
AI.method: 提出TACO管道：闭环跨轨道误差模型触发CVGL，前向偏置五点多作物搜索保持推理成本固定，偏航残差门拒绝与罗盘不一致的定位，各向异性体噪声模型按每帧置信度缩放UKF更新，因子图与验证闭环提供离线平滑轨迹。
AI.result: 在KITTI raw数据集上，中位ATE从97.0米（纯IMU）降至16.3米，降低5.9倍，融合成本<0.1毫秒/帧，相机占空比5-10%。
AI.conclusion: TACO证明紧密耦合IMU与细粒度CVGL可有效替代GNSS进行实时定位，代码已开源。

title: LLM-XTM: Enhancing Cross-Lingual Topic Models with Large Language Models
summary: Cross-lingual topic modeling aims to discover shared semantic structures across languages, yet existing models depend on sparse bilingual resources and often yield incoherent or weakly aligned topics. Recent LLM-based refinements improve interpretability but are costly, document-level, and prone to hallucination, with prior white-box approaches requiring inaccessible token probabilities. We propose LLM-XTM, a framework that integrates LLM-guided topic refinement with self-consistency uncertainty quantification, enabling black-box, stable, and scalable enhancement of cross-lingual topic models. Experiments on multilingual corpora show that LLM-XTM achieves superior topic coherence and alignment while reducing reliance on bilingual dictionaries and expensive LLM calls.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM-XTM框架，利用LLM指导的主题精炼与自一致性不确定性量化，以黑盒方式提升跨语言主题模型的质量，减少对双语资源和昂贵LLM调用的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有跨语言主题模型依赖稀疏的双语资源，主题不一致或对齐弱；LLM改进方法成本高、易产生幻觉，且白盒方法需要不可获取的token概率。
AI.method: 提出LLM-XTM框架，集成LLM指导的主题精炼与自一致性不确定性量化，实现黑盒、稳定、可扩展的跨语言主题模型增强。
AI.result: 在多语言语料上，LLM-XTM实现了更优的主题连贯性和对齐性，同时减少了对双语词典和昂贵LLM调用的依赖。
AI.conclusion: LLM-XTM有效提升了跨语言主题建模的质量与效率，降低了资源需求。

title: Evaluating Prompting and Execution-Based Methods for Deterministic Computation in LLMs
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure. Code and dataset available at https://github.com/bigbird231/llm-exact-computation-dataset
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in natural language understanding and reasoning. However, their ability to perform exact, deterministic computation remains unclear. In this work, we systematically evaluate multiple prompting strategies, including Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Least-to-Most decomposition, Program-of-Thought (PoT), and Self-Consistency (SC), on tasks requiring precise and error-free outputs, including binary counting, longest substring detection, and arithmetic evaluation.
  To support this study, we introduce a synthetic dataset with diverse natural language instructions, enabling controlled evaluation of exact computation across multiple task types.
  Our results show that standard prompting methods achieve only moderate accuracy on sequence-based tasks. CoT provides limited improvement, while Least-to-Most suffers from error accumulation. In contrast, PoT achieves perfect accuracy by generating executable code and delegating computation to an external interpreter. Self-Consistency improves robustness through majority voting, but incurs substantial computational overhead.
  We further train a small domain-specific model (CodeT5-small) to generate executable programs, which achieves perfect accuracy on held-out synthetic test data across all tasks with minimal training cost.
  Overall, our findings suggest that LLMs may simulate reasoning patterns rather than reliably perform exact symbolic computation. For deterministic tasks, combining LLMs with external tools or using specialized models provides a more reliable and efficient solution.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多种提示策略在精确计算任务上的表现，发现LLMs难以可靠执行确定性符号计算，而结合外部工具或使用专用小模型能实现完美准确率。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLMs在自然语言理解和推理方面表现出色，但它们在精确、确定性计算任务上的能力尚不明确，需要系统评估。
AI.method: 引入合成数据集，在二进制计数、最长子串检测和算术评估等任务上，系统比较了CoT、Least-to-Most、PoT和Self-Consistency等多种提示策略的效果。
AI.result: 标准提示方法准确率中等；CoT提升有限；Least-to-Most存在错误累积；PoT通过生成代码调用外部解释器达到完美准确率；Self-Consistency通过多数投票提升鲁棒性但计算开销大。
AI.conclusion: LLMs可能模拟推理模式而非真正执行精确符号计算。对于确定性任务，将LLMs与外部工具结合或使用专用小模型是更可靠高效的解决方案。

title: AHPA: Adaptive Hierarchical Prior Alignment for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Representation alignment has recently emerged as an effective paradigm for accelerating Diffusion Transformer training. Despite their success, existing alignment methods typically impose a fixed supervision target or a fixed alignment granularity throughout the entire denoising trajectory, whether the guidance is provided by external vision encoders, internal self-representations, or VAE-derived features. We argue that such timestep-agnostic alignment is suboptimal because the useful granularity of representation supervision changes systematically with the signal-to-noise ratio. In high-noise regimes, diffusion models benefit more from coarse semantic and layout-level anchoring, whereas in low-noise regimes, the training signal should emphasize spatially detailed and structurally faithful refinement. This non-stationary alignment behavior creates a representational mismatch for static single-level supervisors. To address this issue, we propose Adaptive Hierarchical Prior Alignment (AHPA), a lightweight alignment framework that exploits the hierarchical representations naturally embedded in the frozen VAE encoder. Instead of using only a single compressed latent as the alignment target, AHPA extracts multi-level VAE features that provide complementary priors ranging from local geometry and spatial topology to coarse semantic layout. A timestep-conditioned Dynamic Router adaptively selects and weights these hierarchical priors along the denoising trajectory, thereby synchronizing the alignment granularity with the model's evolving training needs. Extensive experiments show that AHPA improves convergence and generation quality over baselines and incurs no additional inference cost while avoiding external encoder supervision during training.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应分层先验对齐（AHPA）框架，利用VAE编码器中的分层表示，通过时间步条件动态路由器自适应调整对齐粒度，以解决扩散Transformer训练中固定对齐目标导致次优的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有表示对齐方法在整个去噪轨迹中使用固定的监督目标或对齐粒度，忽略了信号噪声比变化导致的有用表示粒度系统性变化，高噪声需粗粒度语义布局锚定，低噪声需细粒度结构细节，静态单级监督造成表示不匹配。
AI.method: 提出AHPA框架：1）从冻结VAE编码器中提取多级特征（局部几何、空间拓扑、粗语义布局）；2）设计时间步条件动态路由器，自适应选择并加权这些分层先验，同步对齐粒度与模型训练需求。
AI.result: 实验表明AHPA在收敛速度和生成质量上优于基线方法，且无需额外推理成本，训练中无需外部编码器监督。
AI.conclusion: AHPA通过动态调整对齐粒度有效解决了扩散Transformer训练中的表示不匹配问题，实现高效高质量生成。

title: cotomi Act: Learning to Automate Work by Watching You
summary: What if a browser agent could learn your work simply by watching you do it? We present cotomi Act, a browser-based computer-using agent that combines reliable multi-step task execution with persistent organizational knowledge learned from user behavior. For execution, an agent scaffold with adaptive lazy observation, verbal-diff-based history compression, coarse-grained actions, and test-time scaling via best-of-N action selection achieves 80.4% on the 179-task WebArena human-evaluation subset, exceeding the reported 78.2% human baseline. For organizational knowledge, a behavior-to-knowledge pipeline passively observes the user's browsing and progressively abstracts it into artifacts (task boards, wiki) exposed through a shared workspace editable by both user and agent. A controlled proxy evaluation confirms that task success improves as behavior-derived knowledge accumulates. In our live demonstration, attendees interact with the system in a real browser, issuing tasks and observing end-to-end autonomous execution and shared knowledge management.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为cotomi Act的浏览器智能体，通过观察用户行为学习并执行任务，在WebArena测试中达到80.4%的成功率，超越了人类基线（78.2%）。
AI.motivation: 探索浏览器智能体是否能够通过被动观察用户操作来学习用户的组织知识，从而实现更可靠的多步骤任务执行。
AI.method: 采用自适应懒加载观察、语言差异历史压缩、粗粒度动作、以及测试时扩展（best-of-N动作选择）等技术的智能体框架；同时设计了行为到知识的管道，将用户浏览行为逐步抽象为任务板和维基等工件。
AI.result: 在WebArena人类评估子集（179个任务）上达到80.4%的成功率，超过人类基线（78.2%）；代理评估表明任务成功率随行为知识的积累而提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过被动观察用户行为积累组织知识，可以显著提升浏览器智能体的任务执行能力，且用户和智能体可通过共享工作空间协同管理知识。

title: FreeTimeGS++: Secrets of Dynamic Gaussian Splatting and Their Principles
summary: The recent surge in 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) has achieved impressive dynamic scene reconstruction. While these methods demonstrate remarkable performance, the specific drivers behind such gains remain less explored, making a systematic understanding of the underlying principles challenging. In this paper, we perform a comprehensive analysis of these hidden factors to provide a clearer perspective on the 4DGS framework. We first establish a controlled baseline, FreeTimeGS_ours, by formalizing and reproducing the heuristics of the state-of-the-art FreeTimeGS. Using this framework, we dissect 4DGS along its fundamental axes and uncover key secrets, including the emergent temporal partitioning driven by Gaussian durations and the discrepancy between photometric fidelity and spatiotemporal consistency. Based on these insights, we propose FreeTimeGS++, a principled method that employs gated marginalization and neural velocity fields to achieve superior stability and robust dynamic representations. Our approach yields reproducible results with reduced run-to-run variance. We will release our implementation to provide a reliable foundation for future 4DGS research.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了4D高斯溅射（4DGS）框架中的隐藏因素，揭示了时间分区和光度-时空一致性差异等关键机制，并提出了改进方法FreeTimeGS++。
AI.motivation: 4DGS在动态场景重建中表现优异，但其性能提升的具体驱动因素尚不明确，缺乏系统性理解。
AI.method: 建立受控基线FreeTimeGS_ours，沿基本轴剖析4DGS，发现高斯持续时间导致的时间分区以及光度保真度与时空一致性之间的差异，并提出FreeTimeGS++，采用门控边缘化和神经速度场。
AI.result: FreeTimeGS++实现了更优的稳定性和鲁棒的动态表示，且具有可重现的结果和更低的运行间方差。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统分析4DGS底层原理，提出了更可靠、可复现的改进方法，为后续研究提供了坚实基础。

title: When to Think, When to Speak: Learning Disclosure Policies for LLM Reasoning
summary: In single-stream autoregressive interfaces, the same tokens both update the model state and constitute an irreversible public commitment. This coupling creates a \emph{silence tax}: additional deliberation postpones the first \emph{task-relevant} content, while naive early streaming risks premature commitments that bias subsequent generations. We introduce \textbf{\emph{Side-by-Side (SxS)}} Interleaved Reasoning, which makes \emph{disclosure timing} a controllable decision within standard autoregressive generation. SxS interleaves partial disclosures with continued private reasoning in the same context, but releases content only when it is \emph{supported} by the reasoning so far. To learn such pacing without incentivizing filler, we construct entailment-aligned interleaved trajectories by matching answer prefixes to supporting reasoning prefixes, then train with SFT to acquire the dual-action semantics and RL to recover reasoning performance under the new format. Across two Qwen3 architectures/scales (MoE \textbf{Qwen3-30B-A3B}, dense \textbf{Qwen3-4B}) and both in-domain (AIME25) and out-of-domain (GPQA-Diamond) benchmarks, SxS improves accuracy--\emph{content-latency} Pareto trade-offs under token-level proxies (e.g., inter-update waiting).

AI.tldr: 提出Side-by-Side (SxS)交错推理方法，解耦公开输出与私有推理过程，通过控制披露时机优化准确率-延迟权衡，在多个模型和基准上取得改进。
AI.motivation: 单流自回归接口中，模型状态更新与公开输出耦合，导致"沉默税"（额外推理延迟首次任务相关输出）与过早流式输出引发偏见的问题。
AI.method: SxS交错推理：将部分披露与持续私有推理交错在同一上下文中，仅在推理充分支持时才输出内容；通过构建蕴含对齐的交错轨迹，结合SFT学习双动作语义和RL恢复推理性能。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和Qwen3-4B上，针对AIME25和GPQA-Diamond基准，SxS改善了准确率-内容延迟的Pareto权衡。
AI.conclusion: 披露时机可作为可控决策，SxS有效解耦了推理与输出，优化了延迟与准确率的平衡。

title: Enhancing Agent Safety Judgment: Controlled Benchmark Rewriting and Analogical Reasoning for Deceptive Out-of-Distribution Scenarios
summary: Tool-using agent systems powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across web, app, operating-system, and transactional environments. Yet existing safety benchmarks still emphasize explicit risks, potentially overstating a model's ability to judge deceptive or ambiguous trajectories. To address this gap, we introduce ROME (Red-team Orchestrated Multi-agent Evolution), a controlled benchmark-construction pipeline that rewrites known unsafe trajectories into more deceptive evaluation instances while preserving their underlying risk labels. Starting from 100 unsafe source trajectories, ROME produces 300 challenge instances spanning contextual ambiguity, implicit risks, and shortcut decision-making. Experiments show that these challenge sets substantially degrade safety-judgment performance, with hidden-risk cases remaining particularly non-trivial even for recent frontier models. We further study ARISE (Analogical Reasoning for Inference-time Safety Enhancement), a retrieval-guided inference-time enhancement that retrieves ReAct-style analogical safety trajectories from an external analogical base and injects them as structured reasoning exemplars. ARISE improves judgment quality without retraining, but is best viewed as a task-specific robustness enhancement rather than a standalone safety guarantee. Together, ROME and ARISE provide practical tools for stress-testing and improving agent safety judgment under deceptive distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROME管道，通过改写已知不安全轨迹生成更具欺骗性的安全评估实例；同时提出ARISE方法，通过检索类比安全轨迹作为推理示例来增强安全判断能力。实验表明ROME生成的挑战集显著降低模型安全判断性能，ARISE能有效提升判断质量但无法作为独立安全保证。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准主要评估显性风险，可能高估模型在欺骗性或模糊轨迹上的判断能力。
AI.method: ROME通过改写100条不安全源轨迹生成300条挑战实例（包含上下文歧义、隐式风险、捷径决策）；ARISE通过检索ReAct风格类比安全轨迹作为结构化推理示例增强安全判断。
AI.result: ROME生成的挑战集显著降低了模型安全判断性能，隐式风险案例即使对前沿模型也极具挑战；ARISE无需重训即可提升判断质量。
AI.conclusion: ROME和ARISE为压力测试和改进智能体在欺骗性分布偏移下的安全判断提供了实用工具。

title: From prompting to evidence-based translation: A RAG+prompt system for Japanese-Chinese translation and its pedagogical potential
summary: Large language models perform well on high-resource pairs but are less reliable for Japanese-Chinese sentences containing noun-modifying clause constructions (NMCCs). This study evaluates a retrieval-augmented generation RAG+Prompt translation system that integrates linguistic analysis, embedding-based retrieval, prompt construction, and LLM generation without modifying the base model. The analysis module outputs A1 (inner vs. outer NMCC) and A2 (risk predictions: lexical choice/NMCC handling/word order/style/register); top-k = 5 similar Ja-Zh examples (L2 distance) and A1/A2 are inserted into an enhanced prompt. Using GPT-4o and a 66-sentence test set, we compare six knowledge-base sizes (0/100/200/500/1,000/2,000). Macro-averaged sentence-level BLEU (1-4-gram with brevity penalty; cased; Chinese at the character level) is the sole metric. Mean BLEU increases from 24.28 at 0 (RAG disabled) to 29.96 at 2,000 (+5.68; +23.4%). The upward trend holds across sizes, with larger knowledge bases yielding higher scores. We conclude that the RAG+Prompt translation system improves Ja-Zh translation of sentences containing NMCCs in an interpretable and auditable manner. Limitations include one base model, one metric, and reliance on published texts and commercial APIs; future work will broaden genres, language pairs, and evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本论文提出了一种RAG+Prompt翻译系统，通过集成语言学分析、嵌入检索、提示构建和LLM生成，显著提升了日语-汉语中含名词修饰从句句子的翻译质量。在66句测试集上，当知识库从0扩展到2000条时，平均BLEU分数从24.28提升至29.96（+23.4%），验证了该方法在低资源语言对上的有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在高资源语言对上表现良好，但在日语-汉语这类包含名词修饰从句（NMCC）结构的句子上可靠性不足，需要探索更有效的翻译方法。
AI.method: 构建RAG+Prompt翻译系统，包含语言学分析模块（输出NMCC内外关系A1和风险预测A2）、嵌入检索（基于L2距离选取top-5相似日汉例句）和增强提示构建，使用GPT-4o作为基础模型，比较六种知识库规模（0/100/200/500/1000/2000）。
AI.result: 宏平均句子级BLEU从无RAG时的24.28提升至2000条知识库时的29.96，增幅达5.68（+23.4%），且BLEU分数随知识库规模增大呈上升趋势。
AI.conclusion: RAG+Prompt翻译系统能够以可解释、可审计的方式改善含NMCC的日汉翻译质量，但受限于单一基础模型、单一评估指标和依赖公开文本与商业API，未来需拓展语料类型、语言对和评估指标。

title: Revisiting the Travel Planning Capabilities of Large Language Models
summary: Travel planning serves as a critical task for long-horizon reasoning, exposing significant deficits in LLMs. However, existing benchmarks and evaluations primarily assess final plans in an end-to-end manner, which lacks interpretability and makes it difficult to analyze the root causes of failures. To bridge this gap, we decompose travel planning into five constituent atomic sub-capabilities, including \emph{Constraint Extraction}, \emph{Tool Use}, \emph{Plan Generation}, \emph{Error Identification}, and \emph{Error Correction}. We implement a decoupled evaluation protocol leveraging oracle intermediate contexts to rigorously isolate these components, thereby measuring the atomic performance boundary without the noise of cascading errors. Our results highlight a clear contrast in performance: while LLMs are proficient in extracting explicit constraints, they struggle to infer implicit, open-world requirements. Furthermore, they exhibit structural biases in plan generation and suffer from ineffective self-correction, characterized by excessive sensitivity and erroneous persistence. These findings offer precise directions for improving LLM reasoning and planning abilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将旅行规划任务分解为五个原子子能力（约束提取、工具使用、计划生成、错误识别、错误修正），并通过解耦评估协议来隔离测试各能力，发现LLM在提取显式约束方面表现良好，但在推断隐含需求、克服结构偏差和有效自我修正方面存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有基准以端到端方式评估最终计划，缺乏可解释性，难以分析失败的根本原因。
AI.method: 将旅行规划分解为五个原子子能力（约束提取、工具使用、计划生成、错误识别、错误修正），利用Oracle中间上下文实现解耦评估协议，单独测量各子能力性能。
AI.result: LLM在提取显式约束上表现良好，但难以推断隐式开放世界需求；在计划生成中存在结构偏差；自我修正存在过度敏感和错误坚持问题。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为改进LLM推理和规划能力提供了精确方向。

title: VLMaxxing through FrameMogging Training-Free Anti-Recomputation for Video Vision-Language Models
comment: 37 pages, 6 figures, 22 tables; code and artifacts available at https://github.com/jfbastien/VLMaxxing
summary:
Video vision-language models (VLMs) keep paying for visual state the stream already told us was stable. The factory wall did not move, but most VLM pipelines still hand the model dense RGB frames or a fresh prefix again. We study that waste as training-free anti-recomputation: reuse state when validation says it survives, and buy fresh evidence when the scene, query, or cache topology requires it.
  The largest measured win is after ingest. On frozen Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct-4bit, adaptive same-video follow-up reuse preserves paired choices and correctness on a 93-query VideoMME breadth setting while reducing follow-up latency by 14.90-35.92x. The first query is still cold; the win starts when later questions reuse the same video state. Stress tests bound the result: repeated-question schedules hold through 50 turns, while dense-answer-anchored prompt variation separates conservative fixed K=1 repair from faster aggressive policies that drift.
  Fresh-video pruning is smaller but real. C-VISION skips timed vision-tower work before the first answer is generated. On Gemma 4-E4B-4bit, the clean 32f short cell reaches 1.316x first-query speedup with no paired drift or parse failures on 20 items; Qwen shows the fidelity/speed boundary.
  Stage-share ceiling (C-CEILING) is the accounting guardrail: a component speedup becomes an end-to-end speedup only in proportion to the wall-clock share it accelerates, so C-VISION and after-ingest follow-up reuse do not multiply. Candidate C-STREAM remains a native-rate target, not a headline result here. The broader direction is VLM-native media that expose change, motion, uncertainty, object state, sensor time, and active tiles directly, so models do not have to rediscover the world from dense RGB every frame.

AI.tldr: 本文研究VLM（视觉-语言模型）中的“反重计算”策略，通过复用稳定的视觉状态来减少计算浪费。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，同视频的后续查询延迟降低14.90-35.92倍；在Gemma 4-E4B上首次查询加速1.316倍。同时提出C-CEILING作为端到端加速的核算边界。
AI.motivation: 当前VLM管线在处理视频时，即使画面内容未变化（如静态工厂墙壁），仍会反复向模型传递密集的RGB帧或新的前缀，导致大量不必要的计算浪费。作者希望消除这种冗余计算。
AI.method: 提出三种训练无关的优化策略：1) 后续复用（after-ingest follow-up reuse）：当验证表明视觉状态稳定时直接复用，否则重新获取；2) 新鲜视频剪枝（fresh-video pruning, C-VISION）：在首次回答生成前跳过部分视觉处理；3) C-CEILING核算框架，确保组件加速按时间占比转换为端到端加速。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，后续查询延迟降低14.90-35.92倍；在Gemma 4-E4B上首次查询加速1.316倍；重复查询可稳定维持50轮；密集答案锚定的提示变化可区分保守策略与激进策略。
AI.conclusion: VLM应原生支持暴露变化、运动、不确定性、物体状态、传感器时间和活动瓦片等媒体特性，使模型无需从每帧密集RGB中重新发现世界。

title: Geolocating News about Extreme Climate Events: A Comparative Analysis of Off-the-Shelf Tools for Toponym Identification in German
comment: Presented at the Fourth International Workshop on Geographic Information Extraction from Texts (GeoExT) at ECIR 2026
summary: Determining the geolocation of extreme climate events and disasters in texts is a common problem in climate impact and adaptation research. Named-entity recognition (NER) tools are typically used to identify a pool of toponyms that serve as candidate event locations. In this study, we conduct a comparative analysis of three off-the-shelf NER tools, namely Flair, Spacy and Stanza. We describe and quantify differences between their outputs for German news articles and evaluate them extrinsically based on three methods to determine the country where events took place. We show how their contrasts are propagated into downstream tasks and can yield distinct decisions about a document's geographical focus, which, in turn, can impact conclusions about countries' prominence in German media.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种NER工具（Flair、Spacy、Stanza）在德语新闻文章中识别极端气候事件地理位置的性能差异，并分析了这些差异如何影响下游任务中关于国家显著性的结论。
AI.motivation: 从文本中确定极端气候事件和灾害的地理位置是气候影响与适应研究的常见问题，但目前对不同NER工具在德语语料上的表现差异及其对下游任务的影响缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 对Flair、Spacy和Stanza三种现成NER工具进行对比分析；使用德语新闻文章作为测试语料；通过三种方法外在地评估工具确定事件发生国家的能力；量化工具输出差异并追踪其在下游任务中的传播效应。
AI.result: 三种NER工具在输出结果上存在显著差异，这些差异会传播到下游任务中，导致关于文档地理焦点的不同判断，进而影响各国在德国媒体报道中显著性的结论。
AI.conclusion: NER工具的选择会实质性影响气候事件地理定位的结果和研究结论，研究者需谨慎选择并理解工具间差异对分析的影响。

title: Automated Large-scale CVRP Solver Design via LLM-assisted Flexible MCTS
summary: Solving large-scale CVRP (LSCVRP) with hundreds to thousands of nodes remains difficult for even state-of-the-art solvers. Divide-and-conquer can scale by decomposing the instance into size-reduced subproblems, but designing decomposition logic and configuring sub-solvers is highly expertise- and labor-intensive. Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as promising tools for automated algorithm design. However, existing LLM-driven approaches struggle with LSCVRP primarily due to the difficulty in generating sophisticated search strategies within a limited context window. To bridge this gap, we propose the LLM-assisted Flexible Monte Carlo Tree Search (LaF-MCTS), a novel framework that automates the design of high-performance LSCVRP solvers. We develop a three-tier decision hierarchy to enable incremental design of decomposition policies and sub-solvers for LSCVRP. To enable efficient search within the algorithmic hypothesis space, we introduce semantic pruning to eliminate semantically and structurally redundant codes, and branch regrowth to regenerate codes and preserve diversity. Extensive experiments on CVRPLib demonstrate that LaF-MCTS autonomously composes and optimizes decomposition-enhanced solvers that surpasses various state-of-the-art CVRP solvers.

AI.tldr: LaF-MCTS是一个利用大语言模型辅助的蒙特卡洛树搜索框架，能够自动设计高性能的大规模CVRP求解器，通过三层决策层次实现分解策略和子求解器的增量设计，并引入语义剪枝和分支再生机制，在CVRPLib数据集上超越了多种最先进的CVRP求解器。
AI.motivation: 大规模CVRP问题（LSCVRP）即使对最先进的求解器来说仍然困难。现有的分治方法需要大量专家经验来设计分解逻辑和子求解器配置，而LLM驱动的自动算法设计方法由于上下文窗口限制，难以生成复杂的搜索策略。
AI.method: 提出了LaF-MCTS（LLM辅助的灵活蒙特卡洛树搜索）框架，包含三个关键技术：(1) 三层决策层次结构，用于增量式设计分解策略和子求解器；(2) 语义剪枝，消除语义和结构冗余代码；(3) 分支再生，重新生成代码以保持多样性。
AI.result: 在CVRPLib数据集上的大量实验表明，LaF-MCTS能够自主组合和优化分解增强型求解器，性能超越了多种最先进的CVRP求解器。
AI.conclusion: LaF-MCTS框架成功地将LLM与MCTS相结合，实现了LSCVRP求解器的自动化设计，有效克服了LLM在复杂搜索策略生成方面的局限性。

title: What Happens Inside Agent Memory? Circuit Analysis from Emergence to Diagnosis
summary: Agent memory failures are silent: an LLM-based agent can produce a fluent response even when it fails to extract, retain, or retrieve the information needed across sessions. The write-manage-read loop describes the external pipeline of these systems but leaves open which internal computations implement each stage. Tracing internal feature circuits across the Qwen-3 family (0.6B--14B) and two memory frameworks (mem0 and A-MEM), we report three findings. First, control is detectable before content: routing circuitry is causally active at 0.6B, while content circuitry produces no detectable signal until 4B under our tracing setup, creating a deployment regime where small models route with apparent competence but silently fail at extraction and grounding. Second, within the content group, Write and Read share a late-layer hub that operates as a context-grounding substrate already present in the base model; only memory framing recruits a functional grounding direction on this substrate, and the hub transfers across both frameworks. Third, emergence does not imply steerability: although the content circuit becomes detectable at 4B, it becomes reliably steerable only at 8B, indicating that detection and intervention have distinct scale thresholds. As a practical implication, the feature-space separation between the two circuit groups enables per-operation failure localization at 76.2% accuracy without supervision, providing a stage-level diagnostic for otherwise silent agent-memory failures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于LLM的智能体记忆模块的内部神经电路机制，发现控制电路与内容电路在模型规模上存在分离：控制电路在0.6B参数时即可检测，内容电路直到4B才出现信号，且直到8B才可被干预。两个电路组的特征空间分离可在无监督条件下实现76.2%的操作级故障定位。
AI.motivation: 智能体记忆失败是"沉默的"——即使未能正确提取、保留或检索信息，LLM仍能生成流利的响应，使得错误难以被发现和定位。现有研究关注外部流水线（写-管理-读循环），但未揭示各阶段内部的神经计算机制，因此需要从特征电路层面理解记忆失败的根源。
AI.method: 在Qwen-3系列（0.6B-14B）和两个记忆框架（mem0和A-MEM）上，追踪内部特征电路，分析控制电路（路由）和内容电路（提取与接地）在不同规模下的因果活性、检测阈值和可操控性。
AI.result: 1）控制电路在0.6B即可检测，内容电路到4B才有信号，小模型看似胜任实际沉默失败；2）Write和Read共享一个晚层枢纽，作为上下文接地基质，记忆框架在该基质上招募功能接地方向；3）内容电路在4B可检测但到8B才可操控，检测与干预存在不同规模阈值；4）两个电路组的特征空间分离可实现76.2%的无监督故障定位。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了智能体记忆系统中控制与内容电路的规模分离现象，为沉默型记忆失败提供了可解释的神经机制解释，并给出了实用的无监督故障定位方法（76.2%准确率），有助于理解和发展更可靠的智能体记忆系统。

title: A Comparison of Traditional Machine Learning Algorithms and LSTM-Based Deep Learning Models for Email Sentiment Analysis
summary: The rapid growth of electronic communication has necessitated more robust systems for email classification and sentiment detection. This study presents a comparative performance analysis between traditional machine learning algorithms and deep learning architectures, specifically focusing on Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). Utilizing Word2Vec embeddings for feature representation, our experimental results indicate that the SVM model with a linear kernel achieves the highest efficiency and accuracy, reaching a peak performance of 98.74%. While the LSTM model demonstrates exceptional recall capabilities in detecting spam-related sentiments, it requires significantly more computational time compared to discriminative statistical models. Detailed evaluations via confusion matrices further reveal that traditional classifiers remain highly robust for dense vector spaces. This research concludes that for email detection tasks, SVM offers the most optimal balance between predictive precision and processing speed. These findings provide critical insights for developing high-performance automated email filtering systems in professional and academic environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了传统机器学习算法（SVM、逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯）与深度学习架构（LSTM）在邮件分类和情感检测中的性能。使用Word2Vec嵌入后，线性核SVM以98.74%的准确率取得最佳效果，兼顾了精度与速度；LSTM召回率出色但计算开销大。结论认为SVM是邮件过滤系统的最优选择。
AI.motivation: 电子通信的快速增长使得邮件分类和情感检测系统需要更加稳健，因此有必要对比传统机器学习和深度学习方法的实际性能差异，以指导系统选型。
AI.method: 采用Word2Vec嵌入进行特征表示，对比SVM（线性核）、逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯和LSTM四种模型，通过混淆矩阵等指标进行详细评估。
AI.result: 线性核SVM取得最高准确率98.74%；LSTM在垃圾邮件情感检测方面召回率突出，但计算时间显著更长；传统分类器在稠密向量空间中依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: 对于邮件检测任务，SVM在预测精度和处理速度之间实现了最优平衡，为构建高性能自动化邮件过滤系统提供了重要参考。

title: ReasonAudio: A Benchmark for Evaluating Reasoning Beyond Matching in Text-Audio Retrieval
summary: As multimodal content continues to expand at a rapid pace, audio retrieval has emerged as a key enabling technology for media search, content organization, and intelligent assistants. However, most existing benchmarks concentrate on semantic matching and fail to capture the fact that real-world queries often demand advanced reasoning abilities, including negation understanding, temporal ordering, concurrent event recognition, and duration discrimination. To address this gap, we introduce ReasonAudio, the first reasoning-intensive benchmark for Text-Audio Retrieval, comprising 1,000 queries and 10,000 composite audio clips across five fundamental reasoning tasks: Negation, Order, Overlap, Duration, and Mix. Despite their intuitive nature for humans and straightforward construction, these tasks pose significant challenges to current models. Our evaluation of ten state-of-the-art models reveals the following findings: All models struggle with reasoning-intensive audio retrieval, performing particularly poorly on Negation and Duration while showing relatively better results on Overlap and Order. Moreover, Multimodal Large Language Model-based embedding models fail to inherit the reasoning capabilities of their backbones through contrastive fine-tuning, suggesting that current training paradigms are insufficient to preserve reasoning capacity in retrieval settings

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReasonAudio，首个面向文本-音频检索的推理密集型基准，包含1000个查询和10000个复合音频片段，覆盖否定、顺序、重叠、时长和混合五种推理任务。评估10个SOTA模型发现：所有模型在推理密集型音频检索上表现不佳，尤其在否定和时长任务上；多模态大语言模型嵌入模型无法通过对比微调继承骨干网络的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有音频检索基准仅聚焦于语义匹配，无法反映真实查询中所需的否定理解、时序排序、并发事件识别和时长判别等高级推理能力。
AI.method: 构建ReasonAudio基准，包含1,000个查询和10,000个复合音频片段，设计否定、顺序、重叠、时长和混合五种推理任务，评估10个SOTA模型。
AI.result: 所有模型在推理密集型音频检索上表现不佳，否定和时长任务最困难，重叠和顺序任务相对较好；多模态大语言模型嵌入模型无法通过对比微调保留骨干网络的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 当前训练范式不足以在检索场景中保留推理能力，亟需面向推理密集型音频检索的新方法。

title: Mix3R: Mixing Feed-forward Reconstruction and Generative 3D Priors for Joint Multi-view Aligned 3D Reconstruction and Pose Estimation
summary: Recent trends in sparse-view 3D reconstruction have taken two different paths: feed-forward reconstruction that predicts pixel-aligned point maps without a complete geometry, and generative 3D reconstruction that generates complete geometry but often with poor input-alignment. We present Mix3R, a novel generative 3D reconstruction method which mixes feed-forward reconstruction and 3D generation into a single framework in an aligned manner. Mix3R generates a 3D shape in two stages: a sparse voxel generation stage and a textured geometry generation stage. Unlike pure generative methods, our first-stage generation jointly produces a coarse 3D structure (sparse voxels), per-view point maps and camera parameters aligned to that 3D structure. This is made possible by introducing a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that inserts global self-attentions to a feed-forward reconstruction model and a 3D generative model, both pretrained on large-scale data. This design effectively retains the pretrained priors but enables better 2D-3D alignment. Based on the initial aligned generations of sparse 3D voxels and point maps, we compute an overlap-based attention bias that is directly added to another pretrained textured geometry generation model, enabling it to correctly place input textures onto generated shapes in a training-free manner. Our design brings mutual benefits to both feed-forward reconstruction and 3D generation: The feed-forward branch learns to ground its predictions to a generative 3D prior, and conversely, the 3D generation branch is conditioned on geometrically informative features from the feed-forward branch. As a result, our method produces 3D shapes with better input alignment compared with pure 3D generative methods, together with camera pose estimations more accurate than previous feed-forward reconstruction methods. Our project page is at https://jsnln.github.io/mix3r/

AI.tldr: Mix3R提出了一种融合前馈重建与3D生成的新型框架，通过两阶段生成（稀疏体素生成+纹理几何生成）实现了更好的输入对齐和相机姿态估计。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏视角3D重建的两条路径（前馈重建和生成式重建）各有优劣：前馈方法预测逐点点图但缺乏完整几何，生成方法产生完整几何但输入对齐差。Mix3R旨在将两者融合，兼顾几何完整性与输入对齐精度。
AI.method: Mix3R采用两阶段生成：1）稀疏体素生成阶段，利用Mixture-of-Transformers架构同时生成稀疏体素、逐视角点图和相机参数，实现2D-3D对齐；2）纹理几何生成阶段，基于第一阶段的稀疏体素和点图计算重叠注意力偏置，以无训练方式引导预训练纹理生成模型正确放置输入纹理。
AI.result: 相比纯3D生成方法，Mix3R生成的3D形状具有更好的输入对齐；相比前馈重建方法，其相机姿态估计更准确。
AI.conclusion: Mix3R通过融合前馈重建与3D生成，使两个分支相互受益：前馈分支学习基于生成先验进行预测，生成分支从几何特征中获取条件信息，最终实现了对齐精度与几何完整性的统一。

title: Sentiment Analysis of Indonesian Spotify Reviews Using Machine Learning and BiLSTM
comment: 8 pages, multiple figures and tables, benchmark study on Indonesian-language Spotify review sentiment classification, compares SVM, Multinomial Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, and BiLSTM, includes class-imbalance discussion and deployment links
summary: This paper benchmarks classical machine learning and deep learning approaches for three-class sentiment classification of Indonesian Spotify reviews. Using 100,000 scraped reviews and 70,155 cleaned samples, the study compares Support Vector Machine, Multinomial Naive Bayes, and Decision Tree models with a two-layer BiLSTM. Both approaches use the same preprocessing pipeline, including slang normalization, stopword removal, and stemming. Decision Tree achieves the best performance among the classical models, while BiLSTM attains the highest weighted F1-score overall but fails on the minority neutral class. The paper concludes that BiLSTM is stronger for overall sentiment detection, whereas machine learning with SMOTE provides more balanced three-class performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文对印尼Spotify评论进行三分类情感分析，比较了SVM、MNB、决策树等机器学习模型与两层BiLSTM深度学习模型。决策树在传统模型中表现最佳，BiLSTM整体加权F1最高但对少数类（中性）表现不佳。SMOTE能提升三类别的均衡性能。
AI.motivation: 针对印尼语Spotify评论的情感分类，探索机器学习与深度学习方法的优劣，尤其是三分类场景下模型对不平衡数据的处理能力。
AI.method: 使用10万条评论（清洗后70,155条），统一预处理流程（俚语归一化、停用词移除、词干提取），对比SVM、MNB、决策树与两层BiLSTM，并引入SMOTE处理类别不平衡。
AI.result: 决策树在传统模型中F1最高；BiLSTM整体加权F1最优，但在中性类别上表现失败；结合SMOTE的机器学习模型在三类均衡性上更好。
AI.conclusion: BiLSTM适合整体情感检测，而结合SMOTE的机器学习模型更适合需要三类平衡性能的场景。

title: GeoDecider: A Coarse-to-Fine Agentic Workflow for Explainable Lithology Classification
summary: Lithology classification aims to infer subsurface rock types from well-logging signals, supporting downstream applications like reservoir characterization. Despite substantial progress, most existing methods still treat lithology classification as a single-pass classification task. In contrast, practical experts incorporate geological principles, external knowledge, and tool-use capabilities to perform accurate classification. In this work, we propose GeoDecider, a coarse-to-fine agentic workflow that enables accurate and explainable lithology classification through training-free use of large language models (LLMs). GeoDecider reformulates lithology classification as an expert-like structured process and organizes it into a multi-stage workflow involving coarse-to-fine reasoning. Specifically, GeoDecider includes the following stages: (1) base classifier-guided coarse classification, which uses a pre-trained classifier to provide a rough reference for downstream tasks, thus reducing the overall cost of downstream reasoning, (2) tool-augmented reasoning, which utilizes several tools such as contextual analysis and neighbor retrieval to achieve finer and more precise classifications, (3) geological refinement, which post-processes the final results to enforce geological consistency. Experiments on four benchmarks show that GeoDecider outperforms representative baselines. Further analysis demonstrates that the proposed framework produces geologically interpretable predictions while achieving a better trade-off between classification performance and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: GeoDecider 是一种基于大语言模型的粗到细智能体工作流，通过无训练的方式将岩性分类重构为多阶段推理过程，在四个基准数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能，并实现了地质可解释性与计算效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有岩性分类方法大多将其视为单次分类任务，而实际专家会结合地质原理、外部知识和工具使用能力进行精确分类。为了弥合这一差距，作者提出一种类似专家的结构化分类流程。
AI.method: GeoDecider 包含三个阶段：(1) 基分类器引导的粗分类——利用预训练分类器提供粗略参考以降低推理成本；(2) 工具增强推理——通过上下文分析和邻域检索等工具实现更精细的分类；(3) 地质精炼——对最终结果进行后处理以确保地质一致性。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上的实验表明，GeoDecider 优于代表性基线方法。进一步分析显示，该框架能够产生地质可解释的预测，并在分类性能与推理效率之间实现了更好的权衡。
AI.conclusion: GeoDecider 通过无训练的大语言模型智能体工作流，成功将岩性分类从单次分类任务转变为结构化的粗到细推理过程，在提升分类精度的同时保持了可解释性和效率。

title: Dynamic Distillation and Gradient Consistency for Robust Long-Tailed Incremental Learning
summary: The task of Long-tailed Class Incremental Learning (LT-CIL) addresses the sequential learning of new classes from datasets with imbalanced class distributions. This scenario intensifies the fundamental problem of catastrophic forgetting, inherent to continual learning, with the dual challenges of under-learning minority classes and overfitting majority classes. To tackle these combined issues, this paper proposes two main techniques.
