For each tile, deSEO selects a minimally shadowed acquisition as a weak reference and pairs it with shadowed counterparts using temporal and geometric filtering, Jacobian-based orientation normalisation, and LoFTR-RANSAC registration. A per-pixel validity mask restricts learning to reliably aligned regions, enabling supervision despite residual off-nadir parallax. In addition to this paired dataset, we develop a DSM-aware deshadowing model that combines residual translation, perceptual objectives, and mask-constrained adversarial learning. In contrast, a direct adaptation of a UAV-based SRNet/pix2pix architecture fails to converge under satellite viewpoint variability. Our model consistently reduces the visual impact of cast shadows across diverse illumination and viewing conditions, achieving improved structural and perceptual fidelity on held-out scenes. deSEO therefore provides the first reproducible, geometry-aware paired dataset and baseline for shadow removal in satellite Earth observation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出deSEO，首个几何感知、物理信息驱动的遥感卫星影像去阴影配对数据集与方法，通过可复现流程从S-EO数据集构建配对监督，并开发DSM感知的去阴影模型，显著提升阴影去除的结构与感知保真度。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率卫星影像中地形和建筑物投射的阴影严重阻碍分类、检测和3D重建等任务，现有资源缺乏几何一致的配对阴影/无阴影卫星图像，且大多数数据集仅针对阴影检测或3D建模而非去除，缺乏可复现的卫星配对数据。
AI.method: 从S-EO阴影检测数据集中，通过时空调度和几何滤波、Jacobian方向归一化、LoFTR-RANSAC配准选择最小阴影采集作为弱参考并配对；开发DSM感知去阴影模型，结合残差翻译、感知目标和掩码约束对抗学习。
AI.result: 模型在多种光照和视角条件下持续减少投射阴影的视觉影响，相比直接迁移UAV的SRNet/pix2pix架构（无法在卫星视角变化下收敛），在结构保真度和感知质量上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: deSEO提供了首个可复现的几何感知配对数据集和基线，为卫星地球观测中的阴影去除奠定了可复现的基础。

title: Natural Language Processing: A Comprehensive Practical Guide from Tokenisation to RLHF
summary: This preprint presents a systematic, research-oriented practicum that guides the reader through the entire modern NLP pipeline: from tokenisation and vectorisation to fine-tuning of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and reinforcement learning from human feedback. Twelve hands-on sessions combine concise theory with detailed implementation plans, formalised evaluation metrics, and transparent assessment criteria. The work is not a conventional textbook: it is designed as a reproducible research artefact where every session requires publishing code, models, and reports in public repositories. All experiments are conducted on a single evolving corpus, and the work advocates open-weight models over commercial APIs, with special attention to the Hugging Face ecosystem. The material is enriched by original research on low-resource languages, incorporating linguistic resources for Tajik and Tatar (subword tokenisers, embeddings, lexical databases, and transliteration benchmarks), demonstrating how modern NLP can be adapted to data-scarce environments. Designed for senior undergraduates, graduate students, and practising developers seeking to implement, compare, and deploy methods from classical ML to state-of-the-art LLM-based systems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个系统性的、以研究为导向的NLP实践课程，涵盖从分词到LLM微调、RAG和RLHF的完整流程，包含12个动手实验，强调可复现性、开放权重模型和对低资源语言（塔吉克语、鞑靼语）的原创研究。
AI.motivation: 现有NLP教材多为理论型或过于商业API导向，缺乏一个完整、可复现、开源的研究实践框架，同时低资源语言的NLP研究与应用严重不足。
AI.method: 设计12个循序渐进的手动实验，每个实验包含精炼理论+详细实现方案+标准化评估指标+透明评分标准；要求代码、模型、报告全部公开；全部实验基于单一演化语料库；倡导使用开放权重模型（Hugging Face生态）而非商业API；融入塔吉克语和鞑靼语的子词分词器、词嵌入、词汇数据库和转写基准等低资源语言资源。
AI.result: 产出一套可复现的NLP实践课程体系，涵盖从经典ML到前沿LLM的全技术栈，并在低资源语言场景下验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为高年级本科生、研究生和开发者提供了一条从理论到实践的完整NLP学习路径，同时展示如何将现代NLP技术适配到数据稀缺的低资源语言环境。

title: Correct Is Not Enough: Training Reasoning Planners with Executor-Grounded Rewards
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a common way to improve explicit reasoning in large language models, but final-answer correctness alone does not reveal whether the reasoning trace is faithful, reliable, or useful to the model that consumes it. This outcome-only signal can reinforce traces that are right for the wrong reasons, overstate reasoning gains by rewarding shortcuts, and propagate flawed intermediate states in multi-step systems. To this end, we propose TraceLift, a planner-executor training framework that treats reasoning as a consumable intermediate artifact. During planner training, the planner emits tagged reasoning. A frozen executor turns this reasoning into the final artifact for verifier feedback, while an executor-grounded reward shapes the intermediate trace. This reward multiplies a rubric-based Reasoning Reward Model (RM) score by measured uplift on the same frozen executor, crediting traces that are both high-quality and useful. To make reasoning quality directly learnable, we introduce TRACELIFT-GROUPS, a rubric-annotated reason-only dataset built from math and code seed problems. Each example is a same-problem group containing a high-quality reference trace and multiple plausible flawed traces with localized perturbations that reduce reasoning quality or solution support while preserving task relevance. Extensive experiments on code and math benchmarks show that this executor-grounded reasoning reward improves the two-stage planner-executor system over execution-only training, suggesting that reasoning supervision should evaluate not only whether a trace looks good, but also whether it helps the model that consumes it.

AI.tldr: 提出TraceLift框架，通过执行器验证的推理奖励来训练规划器，使推理轨迹不仅正确而且对下游模型有用。
AI.motivation: 仅靠最终答案正确性无法判断推理轨迹是否忠实、可靠或对下游模型有用，可能强化"碰巧正确"的推理、夸大推理增益或传播错误中间状态。
AI.method: 采用规划器-执行器两阶段训练框架：规划器生成带标记推理，冻结执行器消费推理产生最终结果；奖励结合基于评分卡的推理奖励模型得分和冻结执行器上的性能提升，同时引入TRACELIFT-GROUPS标注数据集。
AI.result: 在代码和数学基准上，基于执行器验证的推理奖励优于仅靠执行结果训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: 推理监督不仅应评估推理轨迹本身的质量，还应评估其对消费该推理的下游模型的实际帮助程度。

title: Uncertainty Estimation in Instance Segmentation of Affordances via Bayesian Visual Transformers
summary: Visual affordances identify regions in an image with potential interactions, offering a novel paradigm for scene understanding. Recognizing affordances allows autonomous robots to act more naturally, could enhance human-robot interactions, enrich augmented reality systems, and benefit prosthetic vision devices. Accurate and localized prediction of affordance regions, rather than general saliency maps is crucial for these applications. We present a model for instance segmentation of affordances by adopting sample-based and ensembles approaches for uncertainty estimation. We extend an attention-based architecture for our novel task, showing with detailed ablation experiments the effects of each component. By comparing the distribution of these different detections, we extract pixel-wise epistemic and aleatoric variances at both the semantic and spatial levels. In addition, we propose a novel measure called Probability-based Mask Quality, which enables a comprehensive analysis of semantic and spatial variations in a probabilistic instance segmentation model. Our results show that the global consensus of multiple sub-networks of Bayesian models improve deterministic networks due to a better mask refinement and generalization. This fact, joined with the more powerful features extracted by attention-based mechanisms, represent an improvement of +7.4 p.p on the $F_β^w$ score in the challenging IIT-Aff dataset. Bayesian models are also better calibrated, producing less overconfident probabilities and with a better uncertainty estimation. Qualitative results show that aleatoric variance appears in the contour of the objects, while the epistemic variance is observed in visual challenging pixels, adding interpretability to the neural network.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯模型和注意力机制的实例分割方法，用于图像中视觉可交互区域（affordance）的识别，通过不确定性估计和概率掩码质量评估，在IIT-Aff数据集上Fβ^w指标提升7.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 视觉可交互区域识别对自主机器人、人机交互、增强现实和假肢视觉设备具有重要意义，现有方法缺乏精确的局部化预测和不确定性估计。
AI.method: 采用样本集成和贝叶斯方法进行不确定性估计，基于注意力机制架构扩展实现可交互区域实例分割，并提出概率掩码质量（Probability-based Mask Quality）评估指标。
AI.result: 在IIT-Aff数据集上Fβ^w指标提升7.4个百分点，贝叶斯模型校准更好、过自信概率更低，不确定性估计更优。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯多子网络全局共识优于确定性网络，注意力机制提取更强大特征，偶然不确定性出现在物体轮廓，认知不确定性出现在视觉挑战区域，增加了模型可解释性。

title: Reproducing Complex Set-Compositional Information Retrieval
summary: Complex information needs may involve set-compositional queries using conjunction, disjunction, and exclusion, yet it remains unclear whether current retrieval paradigms genuinely satisfy such constraints or exploit `semantic shortcuts'. We conduct a reproducibility study to benchmark major retrieval families and reasoning-targeted methods on QUEST and QUEST+Variants, and introduce LIMIT+, a controlled benchmark where relevance depends on arbitrary attribute predicates and constraint satisfaction, and less on pretrained knowledge. Our findings show that (i) on QUEST, the best neural retrievers achieve an effectiveness that is more than double what can be achieved with BM25 (Recall@100 ${>}$0.41 vs.\ 0.20), but reasoning-targeted methods like ReasonIR and Search-R1 do not outperform general-purpose retrievers uniformly; (ii) on LIMIT+, gains fail to transfer, where the strongest QUEST method collapses from Recall@100${\approx}$0.42 to below 0.02, while classic lexical retrieval gains to ${\sim}$0.96. Lastly, (iii) stratifying by compositional depth reveals a consistent degradation across all methods, where algebraic sparse and lexical methods show more stable performance while dense approaches collapse. We release code and LIMIT+ data generation scripts to support future reproducibility and controlled evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过复现实验发现，当前神经检索器在组合查询（含与、或、排除操作）中存在严重性能缺陷：在标准测试集QUEST上效果显著优于BM25，但在基于属性谓词的新基准LIMIT+上，最强方法Recall@100从0.42骤降至0.02以下，而词法检索方法反升至约0.96，表明现有检索范式依赖“语义捷径”而非真正满足集合组合约束。
AI.motivation: 复杂信息需求常涉及集合组合查询（合取、析取、排除），但现有检索范式是否真正满足此类约束尚不明确，存在利用“语义捷径”的嫌疑，因此需要系统性复现与评估。
AI.method: 在QUEST及QUEST+Variants上复现主流检索家族和推理导向方法，并引入新基准LIMIT+，该基准中相关性与任意属性谓词和约束满足度相关，降低对预训练知识的依赖。
AI.result: (1) QUEST上最佳神经检索器Recall@100>0.41，BM25仅0.20，但ReasonIR和Search-R1未全面超越通用检索器；(2) LIMIT+上最佳QUEST方法Recall@100从0.42跌至0.02以下，词法检索反升至约0.96；(3) 随组合深度增加，所有方法性能持续下降，稀疏和词法方法更稳定，稠密方法崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 现有神经检索方法在组合查询中依赖语义捷径，无法真正满足集合组合约束；词法和稀疏方法在严格约束条件下更可靠；需要更可控的评估基准来推动该领域发展。

title: Quantifying the human visual exposome with vision language models
summary: The visual environment is a fundamental yet unquantified determinant of mental health. While the concept of the environmental exposome is well established, current methods rely on coarse geospatial proxies or biased self reports, failing to capture the first person visual context of daily life. We addressed this gap by coupling ecological momentary assessment with vision language models (VLMs) to quantify the semantic richness of human visual experience. Across 2674 participant generated photographs, VLM derived estimates of greenness robustly predicted momentary affect and chronic stress, consistent with established benchmarks. We then developed a semi autonomous large language model (LLM) based pipeline that mined over seven million scientific publications to extract nearly 1000 environmental features empirically linked to mental health. When applied to real world imagery, up to 33 percent of VLM extracted context ratings significantly correlated with affect and stress. These findings establish a scalable objective paradigm for visual exposomics, enabling high throughput decoding of how the visible world is associated with mental health.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过将生态瞬时评估与视觉语言模型（VLM）相结合，量化了人类视觉体验的语义丰富度，并发现VLM提取的绿色度等环境特征能够显著预测瞬时情绪和慢性压力，从而建立了一种可扩展的、客观的视觉暴露组学范式。
AI.motivation: 视觉环境是影响心理健康的基础因素，但目前缺乏量化的评估方法。现有的暴露组学研究依赖于粗略的地理空间代理或带有偏见的自我报告，无法捕捉日常生活中第一人称的视觉上下文。
AI.method: 1. 结合生态瞬时评估与视觉语言模型（VLM）量化视觉体验的语义丰富度；2. 使用VLM从2674张参与者拍摄的照片中提取绿色度等特征；3. 开发基于大语言模型（LLM）的半自动管道，从超过700万篇科学出版物中挖掘近1000个与心理健康相关的环境特征。
AI.result: VLM估计的绿色度能稳健预测瞬时情绪和慢性压力；将挖掘出的环境特征应用于真实世界图像时，多达33%的VLM提取上下文评级与情绪和压力显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了可扩展、客观的视觉暴露组学范式，实现了高通量解码可见世界与心理健康之间的关联。

title: PriorNet: Prior-Guided Engagement Estimation from Face Video
summary: Engagement estimation from face video remains challenging because facial evidence is often incomplete, labeled data are limited, and engagement annotations are subjective. We present PriorNet, a prior-guided framework that injects task-relevant priors at three stages of the pipeline: preprocessing, model adaptation, and objective design. PriorNet converts face-detection failures into explicit zero-frame placeholders so that missing-face events remain represented in the input sequence, adapts a frozen Self-supervised Video Facial Affect Perceiver (SVFAP) backbone through a Prior-guided Low-Rank Adaptation module (Prior-LoRA) for parameter-efficient specialization, and trains with a Dirichlet-evidential, uncertainty-weighted objective under hard-label supervision. We evaluate PriorNet on EngageNet, DAiSEE, DREAMS, and PAFE using each dataset's native evaluation protocol. Across these benchmarks, PriorNet improves over the strongest listed prior reference within each dataset's evaluation framing, while component ablations on EngageNet and DAiSEE indicate that the gains arise from complementary contributions of preprocessing, adaptation, and objective-level priors. These results support explicit prior injection as a useful design principle for face-video engagement estimation under the benchmark conditions studied in this work.

AI.tldr: PriorNet是一个基于先验知识引导的框架，通过在预处理、模型适配和损失函数三个环节注入任务相关先验信息，显著提升了人脸视频中的参与度估计性能。
AI.motivation: 人脸视频参与度估计面临三大挑战：面部证据常常不完整、标注数据有限、参与度标注具有主观性。现有方法未能有效利用任务先验知识来应对这些问题。
AI.method: PriorNet在三个环节注入先验：1）预处理阶段，将人脸检测失败转换为显式的零帧占位符；2）模型适配阶段，通过Prior-LoRA模块对冻结的SVFAP骨干进行参数高效微调；3）目标设计阶段，采用Dirichlet证据不确定度加权的损失函数进行监督学习。
AI.result: 在EngageNet、DAiSEE、DREAMS和PAFE四个基准数据集上，PriorNet均超越了各数据集评价框架下的最强已有参考方法；消融实验表明三个环节的先验注入均有互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 显式先验注入是面向人脸视频参与度估计的有效设计原则。

title: EvoLM: Self-Evolving Language Models through Co-Evolved Discriminative Rubrics
summary: Language models encode substantial evaluative knowledge from pretraining, yet current post-training methods rely on external supervision (human annotations, proprietary models, or scalar reward models) to produce reward signals. Each imposes a ceiling. Human judgment cannot supervise capabilities beyond its own, proprietary APIs create dependencies, and verifiable rewards cover only domains with ground-truth answers. Self-improvement from a model's own evaluative capacity is a reward source that scales with the model itself, yet remains largely untapped by current methods. We introduce EVOLM, a post-training method that structures this capacity into explicit discriminative rubrics and uses them as training signal. EVOLM trains two capabilities within a single language model in alternation: (1) a rubric generator producing instance-specific evaluation criteria optimized for discriminative utility, which maximizes a small frozen judge's ability to distinguish preferred from dispreferred responses; and (2) a policy trained using those rubric-conditioned scores as reward. All preference signals are constructed from the policy's own outputs via temporal contrast with earlier checkpoints, requiring no human annotation or external supervision. EVOLM trains a Qwen3-8B model to generate rubrics that outperform GPT-4.1 on RewardBench-2 by 25.7%. The co-trained policy achieves 69.3% average on the OLMo3-Adapt suite, outperforming policies trained with GPT-4.1 prompted rubrics by 3.9% and with the state-of-the-art 8B reward model SkyWork-RM by 16%. Overall, EVOLM demonstrates that structuring a model's evaluative capacity into co-evolving discriminative rubrics enables self-improvement without external supervision.

AI.tldr: EVOLM是一种无需外部监督的自我改进方法，通过将语言模型自身的评估能力结构化为显式判别性rubrics，并交替训练rubric生成器和策略模型，实现自我提升，在RewardBench-2和OLMo3-Adapt上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练方法依赖外部监督（人工标注、专有API或标量奖励模型），各自存在天花板：人类无法监督超出自身能力、API产生依赖、可验证奖励仅覆盖有标准答案的领域。而模型自身的评估能力作为奖励来源尚未被充分利用。
AI.method: EVOLM在单一语言模型中交替训练两种能力：(1) Rubric生成器：为每个实例生成判别性评估标准，最大化冻结的小型评判模型区分偏好/非偏好响应的能力；(2) 策略模型：使用rubric条件化分数作为奖励进行训练。所有偏好信号通过时间对比（当前checkpoint与早期checkpoint）从策略自身输出构建，无需人工或外部监督。
AI.result: EVOLM训练的Qwen3-8B生成的rubrics在RewardBench-2上超越GPT-4.1达25.7%；联合训练的策略在OLMo3-Adapt上平均69.3%，超过GPT-4.1提示rubrics训练的3.9%，超过SOTA 8B奖励模型SkyWork-RM达16%。
AI.conclusion: 将模型的评估能力结构化为共进化的判别性rubrics，能够实现无需外部监督的自我改进。

title: RPBA-Net: An Interpretable Residual Pyramid Bilateral Affine Network for RAW-Domain ISP Enhancement
summary: To address module fragmentation, uninterpretable mappings, and deployment constraints in RAW-domain demosaicing, color correction, and detail enhancement, this paper proposes RPBA-Net, an interpretable residual pyramid bilateral affine network for RAW-domain ISP enhancement. Given packed RAW as input, the method performs residual affine base reconstruction by estimating a base RGB representation and learning identity-guided residual affine corrections, thereby unifying demosaicing and enhancement. It further builds pyramid bilateral affine grids and combines guide-driven autoregressive adaptive slicing with adaptive cross-layer fusion to hierarchically model global tone restoration and local texture enhancement. In addition, smoothness, cross-scale consistency, and magnitude regularization terms are introduced to improve model stability, controllability, and structural interpretability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RPBA-Net surpasses representative RAW-to-sRGB methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality, while maintaining low model complexity and strong deployment potential for mobile and embedded platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出RPBA-Net，一种可解释的残差金字塔双边仿射网络，用于RAW域ISP增强，在低复杂度下实现SOTA RAW-to-sRGB性能。
AI.motivation: 解决RAW域去马赛克、色彩校正和细节增强中存在的模块碎片化、映射不可解释以及部署受限问题。
AI.method: 1) 残差仿射基重建：从packed RAW估计基础RGB表示并学习恒等引导的残差仿射校正；2) 金字塔双边仿射网格：结合引导驱动的自回归自适应切片和自适应跨层融合，分层建模全局色调恢复和局部纹理增强；3) 引入平滑性、跨尺度一致性和幅度正则化项。
AI.result: 在重建保真度和感知质量上超越代表性RAW-to-sRGB方法，达到SOTA，同时保持低模型复杂度。
AI.conclusion: RPBA-Net有效统一了去马赛克与增强任务，具备强可解释性和移动/嵌入式平台部署潜力。

title: MCJudgeBench: A Benchmark for Constraint-Level Judge Evaluation in Multi-Constraint Instruction Following
summary: Multi-constraint instruction following requires verifying whether a response satisfies multiple individual requirements, yet LLM judges are often assessed only through overall-response judgments. We introduce MCJudgeBench, a benchmark for constraint-level judge evaluation in multi-constraint instruction following. Each instance includes an instruction, a candidate response, an explicit constraint list, per-constraint gold labels in {yes, partial, no}, and controlled response-side perturbations. The evaluation protocol further includes evaluation prompt variants to test judge stability. We evaluate proprietary and open-source LLM judges using both correctness and inconsistency metrics, distinguishing intrinsic inconsistency under stochastic decoding from procedural inconsistency under prompt and response perturbations. Our results show that judge reliability has multiple dimensions: strong overall performance does not guarantee equally reliable detection across label categories, especially for rarer partial and no cases. Judges with higher correctness do not always have lower inconsistency. Evaluation with reasoning improves correctness but does not uniformly improve stability. These findings motivate evaluating LLM judges at the constraint level to study these failure modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCJudgeBench基准，用于在约束层面评估LLM判断器在多约束指令跟随任务中的可靠性，发现判断器在整体表现好时不一定在各类标签上表现均衡，且正确性与不一致性并非负相关。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM判断器评估通常只基于整体响应判断，忽视了约束级别的细粒度评估，缺乏对判断器在多个约束条件下可靠性的系统评测。
AI.method: 构建MCJudgeBench基准，每条数据包含指令、候选响应、显式约束列表、每个约束的黄金标签（yes/partial/no）以及受控响应扰动；设计评估提示变体测试判断器稳定性；采用正确性和不一致性两类指标，区分内在不一致性（随机解码导致）和过程不一致性（提示与响应扰动导致）。
AI.result: 判断器整体性能强不保证所有标签类别检测均衡，尤其对稀有的partial和no类别表现差；正确性高的判断器不一定不一致性低；使用推理链评估可提升正确性但未必提升稳定性。
AI.conclusion: LLM判断器评估应深入约束级别，以更好地研究其失效模式，从而提升多约束指令跟随场景下的可靠性。

title: QKVShare: Quantized KV-Cache Handoff for Multi-Agent On-Device LLMs
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems on edge devices need to hand off latent context efficiently, but the practical choices today are expensive re-prefill or full-precision KV transfer. We study QKVShare, a framework for quantized KV-cache handoff between agents that combines token-level mixed-precision allocation, a self-contained CacheCard representation, and a HuggingFace-compatible cache injection path. Our current results support a narrower but clearer story than the original draft: on 150 GSM8K problems with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, adaptive quantization remains competitive under repeated handoff and shows its clearest gains against uniform quantization in deeper-hop, higher budget settings; for handoff latency, the QKVShare path reduces TTFT relative to full re prefill at every tested context, from 130.7 ms vs. 150.2 ms at nominal 1K context to 397.1 ms vs. 1029.7 ms at nominal 8K context;. Stage timing shows that post-injection generation, not card creation, dominates the current QKVShare latency path. These results position quantized KV handoff as a promising on-device systems direction while also highlighting the need for stronger controller ablations and apples-to-apples runtime comparisons.

AI.tldr: QKVShare是一个量化KV缓存传递框架，通过令牌级混合精度分配、CacheCard表示和兼容HuggingFace的缓存注入路径，在边缘设备多智能体LLM系统中高效传递潜在上下文，实测相比完整重新预填充显著降低TTFT，但后注入生成阶段是当前延迟瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上的多智能体LLM系统需要高效传递潜在上下文（latent context），但现有方案要么代价高昂地重新预填充（re-prefill），要么使用全精度KV传输，效率低下。
AI.method: 提出QKVShare框架，包含三个核心组件：令牌级混合精度分配（token-level mixed-precision allocation）、自包含的CacheCard表示、以及兼容HuggingFace的缓存注入路径，实现量化KV缓存的智能体间传递。
AI.result: 在150个GSM8K问题、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型上测试：自适应量化在多次传递下保持竞争力，在更深跳数和高预算设置下优势最明显；TTFT全面优于完整重新预填充（1K上下文130.7ms vs 150.2ms，8K上下文397.1ms vs 1029.7ms）；当前延迟瓶颈在后注入生成阶段而非CacheCard创建阶段。
AI.conclusion: 量化KV缓存传递作为端侧系统方向具有潜力，但需要更强的控制器消融实验和公平的运行时对比。

title: CC-OCR V2: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Literacy in Real-world Document Processing
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have recently shown strong performance on Optical Character Recognition (OCR) tasks, demonstrating their promising capability in document literacy. However, their effectiveness in real-world applications remains underexplored, as existing benchmarks adopt task scopes misaligned with practical applications and assume homogeneous acquisition conditions. To address this gap, we introduce CC-OCR V2, a comprehensive and challenging OCR benchmark tailored to real-world document processing. CC-OCR V2 focuses on practical enterprise document processing tasks and incorporates hard and corner cases that are critical yet underrepresented in prior benchmarks, covering 5 major OCR-centric tracks: text recognition, document parsing, document grounding, key information extraction, and document question answering, comprising 7,093 high-difficulty samples. Extensive experiments on 14 advanced LMMs reveal that current models fall short of real-world application requirements. Even state-of-the-art LMMs exhibit substantial performance degradation across diverse tasks and scenarios. These findings reveal a significant gap between performance on current benchmarks and effectiveness in real-world applications. We release the full dataset and evaluation toolkit at https://github.com/eioss/CC-OCR-V2.

AI.tldr: CC-OCR V2是一个针对真实世界文档处理场景的高难度OCR基准测试，包含5大核心任务和7,093个样本，实验发现当前最先进的多模态大模型在实际应用中表现远不如现有基准测试所示。
AI.motivation: 现有OCR基准测试与真实应用场景脱节，任务范围不匹配且假设采集条件同质化，缺乏对实际企业文档处理中关键且未被充分覆盖的困难样例和边界情况的关注。
AI.method: 构建CC-OCR V2基准，聚焦5个OCR核心任务（文本识别、文档解析、文档定位、关键信息抽取、文档问答），包含7,093个高难度样本，并在14个先进多模态大模型上进行系统评估。
AI.result: 当前LMMs在真实应用场景中表现远未达到实际需求，即使最先进的模型在不同任务和场景下也出现显著性能下降，现有基准测试与真实应用之间存在巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: CC-OCR V2揭示了LMMs在真实文档处理中的不足，为未来研究提供了更具挑战性和实用性的评估基准。

title: Contextual Multi-Objective Optimization: Rethinking Objectives in Frontier AI Systems
summary: Frontier AI systems perform best in settings with clear, stable, and verifiable objectives, such as code generation, mathematical reasoning, games, and unit-test-driven tasks. They remain less reliable in open-ended settings, including scientific assistance, long-horizon agents, high-stakes advice, personalization, and tool use, where the relevant objective is ambiguous, context-dependent, delayed, or only partially observable. We argue that many such failures are not merely failures of scale or capability, but failures of objective selection: the system optimizes a locally visible signal while missing which objectives should govern the interaction. We formulate this problem as \emph{contextual multi-objective optimization}. In this setting, systems must consider multiple, context-dependent objectives, such as helpfulness, truthfulness, safety, privacy, calibration, non-manipulation, user preference, reversibility, and stakeholder impact, while determining which objectives are active, which are soft preferences, and which must function as hard or quasi-hard constraints. These examples are not intended as an exhaustive taxonomy: different domains and deployment settings may activate different objective dimensions and different conflict-resolution procedures. Our framework models AI behavior as a context-dependent choice rule over candidate actions, objective estimates, active constraints, stakeholders, uncertainty, and conflict-resolution procedures. We outline an implementation pathway based on decomposed objective representations, context-to-objective routing, hierarchical constraints, deliberative policy reasoning, controlled personalization, tool-use control, diagnostic evaluation, auditing, and post-deployment revision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，前沿AI系统在开放场景下的失败并非能力不足，而是目标选择失败（即系统优化了局部可见信号，却忽略了应主导交互的正确目标），并将此问题形式化为“上下文多目标优化”框架。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统在目标清晰的任务（如代码生成、数学推理）中表现优异，但在科学辅助、长期智能体、高风险建议等开放场景中可靠性不足。作者认为这些失败并非缩放或能力问题，而是系统未能正确选择应优化的目标（如有用性、真实性、安全性、隐私等），因此需要明确建模目标选择问题。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为“上下文多目标优化”：系统需考虑多个上下文相关的目标（如帮助性、真实性、安全性、隐私、校准、非操纵性、用户偏好、可逆性、利益相关者影响等），并判断哪些目标是激活的、哪些是软偏好、哪些是硬约束。提出实现路径包括：分解目标表示、上下文到目标的路由、分层约束、审慎策略推理、受控个性化、工具使用控制、诊断评估、审计和部署后修订。
AI.result: 提出了一个框架，将AI行为建模为依赖于上下文的选择规则，该规则作用于候选动作、目标估计、激活约束、利益相关者、不确定性和冲突解决程序。给出了从分解表示到部署后修订的完整实现路径。
AI.conclusion: AI系统在开放场景中的可靠性问题根源在于目标选择错误，通过上下文多目标优化框架，系统能够更好地处理目标冲突、上下文依赖和不确定性，从而提升在复杂真实场景中的表现。

title: Steer Like the LLM: Activation Steering that Mimics Prompting
summary: Large language models can be steered at inference time through prompting or activation interventions, but activation steering methods often underperform compared to prompt-based approaches. We propose a framework that formulates prompt steering as a form of activation steering and investigates whether distilling successful prompt steering behavior into simpler, interpretable models can close this gap. Our analysis reveals that popular activation steering methods are not faithful to the mechanics of prompt steering, which applies strong interventions on some tokens while barely affecting others. Based on these insights, we introduce Prompt Steering Replacement (PSR) models that estimate token-specific steering coefficients from the activations themselves and are trained to imitate prompt-based interventions. Experiments on three steering benchmarks across multiple language models show that PSR models outperform existing activation steering methods, especially when controlling for high-coherence completions, and also compare favorably to prompting on AxBench and persona steering.

AI.tldr: 提出PSR框架，通过将提示引导蒸馏为激活引导，弥合了两者之间的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 激活引导方法在推理时性能往往不如提示引导，现有方法未能忠实模拟提示引导的逐token强干预机制。
AI.method: 提出Prompt Steering Replacement (PSR)模型，从激活值本身估计token特定的引导系数，训练模仿提示引导行为。
AI.result: 在三个引导基准测试及多个语言模型上，PSR优于现有激活引导方法，在高连贯性控制下表现突出；在AxBench和人物引导上与提示引导相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过蒸馏提示引导行为到可解释的PSR模型，可以有效缩小激活引导与提示引导之间的性能差距。

title: From Intent to Execution: Composing Agentic Workflows with Agent Recommendation
summary: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) built using AI agents fulfill a variety of user intents that may be used to design and build a family of related applications. However, the creation of such MAS currently involves manual composition of the plan, manual selection of appropriate agents, and manual creation of execution graphs. This paper introduces a framework for the automated creation of multi-agent systems which replaces multiple manual steps with an automated framework. The proposed framework consists of software modules and a workflow to orchestrate the requisite task- specific application. The modules include: an LLM-derived planner, a set of tasks described in natural language, a dynamic call graph, an orchestrator for map agents to tasks, and an agent recommender that finds the most suitable agent(s) from local and global agent registries. The agent recommender uses a two-stage information retrieval (IR) system comprising a fast retriever and an LLM-based re-ranker. We implemented a series of experiments exploring the choice of embedders, re- rankers, agent description enrichment, and supervising critique agent. We benchmarked this system end-to-end, evaluating the combination of planning, agent selection, and task completion, with our proposed approach. Our experimental results show that our approach outperforms the state-of-the- art in terms of the recall rate and is more robust and scalable compared to previous approaches. The critique agent holistically reevaluates both agent and tool recommendations against the overall plan. We show that the inclusion of the critique agent further enhances the recall score, proving that the comprehensive review and revision of task-based agent selection is an essential step in building end-to-end multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自动化创建多智能体系统的框架，用LLM驱动的工作流替代人工规划、智能体选择和执行图构建，通过两阶段信息检索和批判智能体机制，在召回率和扩展性上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 当前构建多智能体系统需要手动组合计划、手动选择智能体以及手动创建执行图，流程繁琐低效，亟需自动化替代方案。
AI.method: 提出包含LLM规划器、自然语言任务描述、动态调用图、任务-智能体映射编排器、两阶段信息检索（快速检索+LLM重排序）的智能体推荐器，以及全局审查的批判智能体。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在召回率上超越现有最优方案，且更鲁棒和可扩展；批判智能体的引入进一步提升了召回率。
AI.conclusion: 端到端多智能体系统中，基于任务的智能体选择的全面审查与修订是关键环节，本文提出的自动化框架有效解决了手动构建的瓶颈。

title: Rethinking Temporal Consistency in Video Object-Centric Learning: From Prediction to Correspondence
summary: The de facto approach in video object-centric learning maintains temporal consistency through learned dynamics modules that predict future object representations, called slots. We demonstrate that these predictors function as expensive approximations of discrete correspondence problems. Modern self-supervised vision backbones already encode instance-discriminative features that distinguish objects reliably. Exploiting these features eliminates the need for learned temporal prediction. We introduce Grounded Correspondence, a framework that replaces learned transition functions with deterministic bipartite matching. Slots initialize from salient regions in frozen backbone features. Frame-to-frame identity is maintained through Hungarian matching on slot representations. The approach requires zero learnable parameters for temporal modeling yet achieves competitive performance on MOVi-D, MOVi-E, and YouTube-VIS. Project page: https://magenta-sherbet-85b101.netlify.app/

AI.tldr: 本文提出Grounded Correspondence框架，利用现成自监督视觉骨干网络的实例判别特征，通过确定性二分图匹配替代传统学习型动力学模块，实现视频目标中心学习中的时序一致性，无需任何可学习参数进行时序建模。
AI.motivation: 传统视频目标中心学习方法依赖学习型动力学模块预测未来目标表征（slots），但这些方法本质上是离散对应问题的昂贵近似。作者希望利用现代自监督视觉骨干网络已具备的实例判别能力，消除对学习型时序预测的需求。
AI.method: Slots从冻结骨干网络特征中的显著区域初始化；帧间身份一致性通过匈牙利匹配在slot表征上维持；用确定性二分图匹配替代传统学习型时序过渡函数。
AI.result: 在MOVi-D、MOVi-E和YouTube-VIS数据集上达到与现有方法竞争的性能，且时序建模部分零可学习参数。
AI.conclusion: 证明了学习型时序预测器在视频目标中心学习中是不必要的，利用现成骨干网络的判别特征配合确定性匹配即可有效维持时序一致性，为简化该类方法提供了新思路。

title: An Agent-Oriented Pluggable Experience-RAG Skill for Experience-Driven Retrieval Strategy Orchestration
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems often assume that one fixed retrieval pipeline is sufficient across heterogeneous tasks, yet factoid question answering, multi-hop reasoning, and scientific verification exhibit different retrieval preferences. We present Experience-RAG Skill, an agent-oriented pluggable retrieval orchestration layer positioned between the agent and the retriever pool. The proposed skill analyzes the current scene, consults an experience memory, selects an appropriate retrieval strategy, and returns structured evidence to the agent. Under a fixed candidate pool, Experience-RAG Skill achieves an overall nDCG@10 of 0.8924 on BeIR/nq, BeIR/hotpotqa, and BeIR/scifact, outperforming fixed single-retriever baselines and remaining competitive with Adaptive-RAG-style routing. The results suggest that retrieval strategy selection can be productively encapsulated as a reusable agent skill rather than being hard-coded in the upper workflow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Experience-RAG Skill，一种可插拔的检索编排层，能够根据任务场景从经验记忆中选择合适的检索策略，在异构任务上优于固定检索流程。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统通常假设单一固定检索流程适用于所有异构任务，但事实性问答、多跳推理和科学验证等任务对检索策略的需求各不相同。
AI.method: 提出Experience-RAG Skill，作为智能体与检索器池之间的可插拔检索编排层，通过分析当前场景、查询经验记忆、选择合适的检索策略，并向智能体返回结构化证据。
AI.result: 在BeIR/nq、BeIR/hotpotqa和BeIR/scifact上，固定候选池下nDCG@10达到0.8924，优于固定单检索器基线，与Adaptive-RAG风格路由性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 检索策略选择可以封装为可复用的智能体技能，而非硬编码在上层工作流中。

title: AniMatrix: An Anime Video Generation Model that Thinks in Art, Not Physics
comment: 37 pages, 1 main figure (qualitative comparison), 1 TikZ architecture diagram; technical report. Model weights and inference code to be released
summary: Video generation models internalize physical realism as their prior. Anime deliberately violates physics: smears, impact frames, chibi shifts; and its thousands of coexisting artistic conventions yield no single "physics of anime" a model can absorb. Physics-biased models therefore flatten the artistry that defines the medium or collapse under its stylistic variance. We present AniMatrix, a video generation model that targets artistic rather than physical correctness through a dual-channel conditioning mechanism and a three-step transition: redefine correctness, override the physics prior, and distinguish art from failure. First, a Production Knowledge System encodes anime as a structured taxonomy of controllable production variables (Style, Motion, Camera, VFX), and AniCaption infers these variables from pixels as directorial directives. A trainable tag encoder preserves the field-value structure of this taxonomy while a frozen T5 encoder handles free-form narrative; dual-path injection (cross-attention for fine-grained control, AdaLN modulation for global enforcement) ensures categorical directives are never diluted by open-ended text. Second, a style-motion-deformation curriculum transitions the model from near-physical motion to full anime expressiveness. Third, deformation-aware preference optimization with a domain-specific reward model separates intentional artistry from pathological collapse. On an anime-specific human evaluation with five production dimensions scored by professional animators, AniMatrix ranks first on four of five, with the largest gains over Seedance-Pro 1.0 on Prompt Understanding (+0.70, +22.4 percent) and Artistic Motion (+0.55, +16.9 percent). We will publicly release the AniMatrix model weights and inference code.

AI.tldr: AniMatrix是一个面向动漫视频生成的专业模型，通过双通道条件机制和三阶段训练策略（重新定义正确性、覆盖物理先验、区分艺术与失败），在保留动漫艺术表现力的同时实现高质量视频生成，在专业动画师评估的5个维度中4项排名第一。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型内化了物理真实感作为先验知识，但动漫作品有意违反物理规律（如拖影、冲击帧、Q版变形），且存在数千种共存的艺术惯例，不存在统一的"动漫物理"。物理偏置的模型要么抹平了动漫的艺术性，要么在风格变化下崩溃。
AI.method: 1) 双通道条件机制：Production Knowledge System将动漫编码为可控制作变量（风格、运动、相机、VFX）的结构化分类体系，AniCaption从像素推断变量；可训练标签编码器保留结构，冻结T5编码器处理自由文本，通过交叉注意力（精细控制）和AdaLN调制（全局执行）双路径注入。2) 风格-运动-变形课程学习，从近物理运动过渡到完整动漫表现力。3) 变形感知偏好优化，结合领域特定奖励模型区分有意艺术性与病态崩溃。
AI.result: 在专业动画师对5个制作维度的人类评估中，AniMatrix在4个维度上排名第一，相较于Seedance-Pro 1.0在提示理解（+0.70，+22.4%）和艺术运动（+0.55，+16.9%）上提升最大。
AI.conclusion: AniMatrix通过结构化知识编码和分阶段训练，成功解决了物理偏置模型在动漫生成中的不足，实现了艺术正确而非物理正确的视频生成。

title: The Counterexample Game: Iterated Conceptual Analysis and Repair in Language Models
summary: Conceptual analysis -- proposing definitions and refining them through counterexamples -- is central to philosophical methodology. We study whether language models can perform this task through iterated analysis and repair chains: one model instance generates counterexamples to a proposed definition, another repairs the definition, and the process repeats. Across 20 concepts and thousands of counterexample-repair cycles, we find that, although many LM-generated counterexamples are judged invalid by both expert humans and an LM judge, the LM judge accepts roughly twice as many as humans do. Nonetheless, per-item validity judgments are moderately consistent across humans and between humans and the LM. We further find that extended iteration produces increasingly verbose definitions without improving accuracy. We also see that some concepts resist stable definitions in general. These findings suggest that while LMs can engage in philosophical reasoning, the counterexample-repair loop hits diminishing returns quickly and could be a fruitful test case for evaluating whether LMs can sustain high-level iterated philosophical reasoning.

AI.tldr: 研究语言模型能否通过迭代分析和修复链执行哲学中的概念分析任务（提出定义并通过反例完善），发现虽然LM能参与哲学推理，但反例-修复循环会快速出现收益递减。
AI.motivation: 概念分析（提出定义并通过反例完善）是哲学方法论的核心，但语言模型能否执行这一高阶迭代推理任务尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建迭代分析与修复链：一个模型实例生成反例，另一个模型修复定义，如此循环。覆盖20个概念和数千个反例-修复周期，并引入人类专家和LM评判者进行评估。
AI.result: LM生成的许多反例被人类判断为无效，LM评判者接受率约为人类的两倍；人机判断存在中等一致性；迭代使定义变长但未提升准确性；部分概念难以形成稳定定义。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可以参与哲学推理，但反例-修复循环会快速出现收益递减，可作为评估LM高阶迭代推理能力的测试案例。

title: Real Image Denoising with Knowledge Distillation for High-Performance Mobile NPUs
summary: While deep-learning-based image restoration has achieved unprecedented fidelity, deployment on mobile Neural Processing Units (NPUs) remains bottlenecked by operator incompatibility and memory-access overhead. We propose an NPU-aware hardware-algorithm co-design approach for real-world image denoising on mobile NPUs. Our approach employs a high-capacity teacher to supervise a lightweight student network specifically designed to leverage the tiled-memory architectures of modern mobile SoCs. By prioritizing NPU-native primitives -- standard 3x3 convolutions, ReLU activations, and nearest-neighbor upsampling -- and employing a progressive context expansion strategy (up to 1024x1024 crops), the model achieves 37.66 dB PSNR / 0.9278 SSIM on the validation benchmark and 37.58 dB PSNR / 0.9098 SSIM on the held-out test benchmark at full resolution (2432x3200) in the Mobile AI 2026 challenge. Following the official challenge rules, the inference runtime is measured under a standardized Full HD (1088x1920) protocol, where it runs in 34.0 ms on the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 and 46.1 ms on the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite NPU. We further reveal an "Inference Inversion" effect, where strict adherence to NPU-compatible operations enables dedicated NPU execution up to 3.88x faster than the integrated mobile GPU. The 1.96M-parameter student recovers 99.8% of the teacher's restoration quality via high-alpha knowledge distillation (alpha = 0.9), achieving a 21.2x parameter reduction while closing the PSNR gap from 1.63 dB to only 0.05 dB. These results establish hardware-aware distillation as an effective strategy for unifying high-fidelity denoising with practical deployment across diverse mobile NPU architectures. The proposed lightweight student model (LiteDenoiseNet) and its training statistics are provided in the NN Dataset, available at https://github.com/ABrain-One/NN-Dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向移动NPU的硬件-算法协同设计方法，通过知识蒸馏将高容量教师网络压缩为仅1.96M参数的轻量级学生网络（LiteDenoiseNet），在保持99.8%恢复质量的同时实现21.2倍参数缩减，并在MediaTek Dimensity 9500和Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite NPU上分别达到34.0ms和46.1ms的推理速度。
AI.motivation: 基于深度学习的图像恢复在移动NPU上面临算子不兼容和内存访问开销大的部署瓶颈，现有方法难以兼顾高保真度恢复与移动端实时推理。
AI.method: 采用高容量教师网络监督轻量级学生网络，学生网络专门设计以适配移动SoC的平铺内存架构，优先使用NPU原生算子（3x3卷积、ReLU、最近邻上采样），并结合渐进式上下文扩展策略（最大1024x1024裁剪）和高alpha知识蒸馏（alpha=0.9）。
AI.result: 在验证集上达到37.66 dB PSNR/0.9278 SSIM，测试集上37.58 dB PSNR/0.9098 SSIM；Full HD协议下推理速度34.0ms（Dimensity 9500）和46.1ms（Snapdragon 8 Elite）；发现"推理反转"效应，NPU执行速度比GPU快3.88倍。
AI.conclusion: 硬件感知蒸馏是将高保真去噪与移动NPU实用部署相结合的有效策略，为跨不同移动NPU架构的实时图像恢复提供了可行方案。

title: Feature-Augmented Transformers for Robust AI-Text Detection Across Domains and Generators
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to ICML 2026
summary: AI-generated text is nowadays produced at scale across domains and heterogeneous generation pipelines, making robustness to distribution shift a central requirement for supervised binary detectors. We train transformer-based detectors on HC3 PLUS and calibrate a single decision threshold by maximising balanced accuracy on held-out validation; this threshold is then kept fixed for all downstream test distributions, revealing domain- and generator-dependent error asymmetries under shift. We evaluate in-domain on HC3 PLUS, under cross-dataset transfer to the multi-domain, multi-generator M4 benchmark, and on the external AI-Text-Detection-Pile. Although base models achieve near-ceiling in-domain performance (up to 99.5% balanced accuracy), performance under shift is brittle and strongly model-dependent. Feature augmentation via attention-based linguistic feature fusion improves transfer, with our best model (DeBERTa-v3-base+FeatAttn) achieving 85.9% balanced accuracy on M4. Multi-seed experiments confirm high stability. Under the same fixed-threshold protocol, our model outperforms strong zero-shot baselines by up to +7.22 points. Category-level ablations further show that readability and vocabulary features contribute most to robustness under shift. Overall, these results demonstrate that feature augmentation and a modern DeBERTa backbone significantly outperform earlier BERT/RoBERTa models, while the fixed-threshold protocol provides a more realistic and informative assessment of practical detector robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究AI生成文本检测器在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，通过在HC3 PLUS上训练基于Transformer的检测器并固定决策阈值，发现域内性能接近完美（99.5%），但跨域迁移时性能下降严重。通过注意力机制融合语言特征（DeBERTa-v3-base+FeatAttn）在M4基准上达到85.9%的平衡准确率，优于强零样本基线最多7.22个百分点。可读性和词汇特征对鲁棒性贡献最大。
AI.motivation: AI生成文本跨域、跨管线大规模生产，监督二元检测器对分布偏移的鲁棒性成为核心需求，但现有研究缺乏在固定阈值协议下对跨域迁移性能的系统评估。
AI.method: 在HC3 PLUS上训练Transformer检测器（BERT/RoBERTa/DeBERTa等），通过最大化验证集平衡准确率校准单一决策阈值并固定不变；提出FeatAttn注意力机制融合语言特征（可读性、词汇等）进行特征增强。
AI.result: 域内性能达99.5%平衡准确率；跨域迁移至M4基准，DeBERTa-v3-base+FeatAttn达85.9%平衡准确率，多种子实验验证高稳定性；超越零样本基线最高7.22个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 特征增强与现代DeBERTa骨干显著优于早期BERT/RoBERTa模型；固定阈值协议提供了更实际、更有信息的检测器鲁棒性评估；可读性和词汇特征是跨域鲁棒性的关键贡献因素。

title: Redefining AI Red Teaming in the Agentic Era: From Weeks to Hours
summary:
AI systems are entering critical domains like healthcare, finance, and defense, yet remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. While AI red teaming is a primary defense, current approaches force operators into manual, library-specific workflows. Operators spend weeks hand-crafting workflows - assembling attacks, transforms, and scorers. When results fall short, workflows must be rebuilt. As a result, operators spend more time constructing workflows than probing targets for security and safety vulnerabilities.
  We introduce an AI red teaming agent built on the open-source Dreadnode SDK. The agent creates workflows grounded in 45+ adversarial attacks, 450+ transforms, and 130+ scorers. Operators can probe multi-agent systems, multilingual, and multimodal targets, focusing on what to probe rather than how to implement it.
  We make three contributions: 1. Agentic interface. Operators describe goals in natural language via the Dreadnode TUI (Terminal User Interface). The agent handles attack selection, transform composition, execution, and reporting, letting operators focus on red teaming. Weeks compress to hours. 2. Unified framework. A single framework for probing traditional ML models (adversarial examples) and generative AI systems (jailbreaks), removing the need for separate libraries. 3. Llama Scout case study. We red team Meta Llama Scout and achieve an 85% attack success rate with severity up to 1.0, using zero human-developed code

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于Dreadnode SDK的AI红队智能体，通过自然语言界面和统一框架，将传统ML模型和生成式AI系统的渗透测试工作从数周缩短至数小时，并在Meta Llama Scout上实现了85%的攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前AI红队工作依赖手动、特定库的工作流，操作员需要花数周手工构建攻击、变换和评分流程，且结果不佳时需重建工作流，导致大量时间花在构建而非实际安全探测上。
AI.method: 基于开源Dreadnode SDK构建AI红队智能体，集成45+对抗攻击、450+变换和130+评分器，提供自然语言终端界面，自动完成攻击选择、变换组合、执行和报告生成，支持多智能体、多语言和多模态目标探测。
AI.result: 在Meta Llama Scout红队测试中实现了85%的攻击成功率，严重程度最高达1.0，且无需人类编写任何代码。
AI.conclusion: 该智能体通过自然语言接口和统一框架，将红队工作从数周压缩至数小时，消除了对多个独立库的需求，显著提升AI系统安全性评估的效率。

title: Unified Multimodal Visual Tracking with Dual Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Multimodal visual object tracking can be divided into to several kinds of tasks (e.g. RGB and RGB+X tracking), based on the input modality. Existing methods often train separate models for each modality or rely on pretrained models to adapt to new modalities, which limits efficiency, scalability, and usability. Thus, we introduce OneTrackerV2, a unified multi-modal tracking framework that enables end-to-end training for any modality. We propose Meta Merger to embed multi-modal information into a unified space, allowing flexible modality fusion and robustness. We further introduce Dual Mixture-of-Experts (DMoE): T-MoE models spatio-temporal relations for tracking, while M-MoE embeds multi-modal knowledge, disentangling cross-modal dependencies and reducing feature conflicts. With a shared architecture, unified parameters, and a single end-to-end training, OneTrackerV2 achieves state-of-the-art performance across five RGB and RGB+X tracking tasks and 12 benchmarks, while maintaining high inference efficiency. Notably, even after model compression, OneTrackerV2 retains strong performance. Moreover, OneTrackerV2 demonstrates remarkable robustness under modality-missing scenarios.

AI.tldr: OneTrackerV2是一个统一的多模态视觉跟踪框架，通过Meta Merger和双专家混合（DMoE）模块，实现单一模型在多种RGB和RGB+X跟踪任务上的端到端训练，在12个基准上取得SOTA性能，并具备高推理效率和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法针对不同模态需要单独训练模型或依赖预训练模型进行适配，导致效率低、可扩展性差、可用性受限。
AI.method: 提出统一的多模态跟踪框架OneTrackerV2，包含Meta Merger（将多模态信息嵌入统一空间）和Dual Mixture-of-Experts（T-MoE建模时空关系，M-MoE嵌入多模态知识，解耦跨模态依赖并减少特征冲突）。
AI.result: 在5个RGB和RGB+X跟踪任务、12个基准上取得SOTA性能，保持高推理效率；模型压缩后仍保持强性能；在模态缺失场景下表现出显著鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: OneTrackerV2通过共享架构、统一参数和单一端到端训练，验证了用一个模型解决多模态跟踪任务的可行性和优越性。

title: Logical Consistency as a Bridge: Improving LLM Hallucination Detection via Label Constraint Modeling between Responses and Self-Judgments
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are prone to factual hallucinations, risking their reliability in real-world applications. Existing hallucination detectors mainly extract micro-level intrinsic patterns for uncertainty quantification or elicit macro-level self-judgments through verbalized prompts. However, these methods address only a single facet of the hallucination, focusing either on implicit neural uncertainty or explicit symbolic reasoning, thereby treating these inherently coupled behaviors in isolation and failing to exploit their interdependence for a holistic view. In this paper, we propose LaaB (Logical Consistency-as-a-Bridge), a framework that bridges neural features and symbolic judgments for hallucination detection. LaaB introduces a "meta-judgment" process to map symbolic labels back into the feature space. By leveraging the inherent logical bridge where response and meta-judgment labels are either the same or opposite based on the self-judgment's semantics, LaaB aligns and integrates dual-view signals via mutual learning and enhances the hallucination detection. Extensive experiments on 4 public datasets, across 4 LLMs, against 8 baselines demonstrate the superiority of LaaB.

AI.tldr: LaaB提出了一种通过逻辑一致性桥接神经特征与符号判断的幻觉检测框架，利用元判断过程将符号标签映射回特征空间，实现双向信号对齐与融合，显著提升了大语言模型幻觉检测效果。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法仅关注单一层面（隐式神经不确定性或显式符号推理），忽视了二者内在的耦合关系与相互依赖，无法形成整体视角。
AI.method: 提出LaaB框架，引入"元判断"过程将符号标签映射回特征空间，利用响应与元判断标签之间的逻辑一致性（相同或相反）关系，通过互学习对齐和融合双视角信号。
AI.result: 在4个公开数据集上，针对4种LLM、与8个基线方法对比，LaaB表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: LaaB有效桥接了神经特征与符号判断，证明利用二者的逻辑一致性互学习能够更全面地检测幻觉，提升检测效果。

title: OpenSeeker-v2: Pushing the Limits of Search Agents with Informative and High-Difficulty Trajectories
summary: Deep search capabilities have become an indispensable competency for frontier Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet their development remains dominated by industrial giants. The typical industry recipe involves a highly resource-intensive pipeline spanning pre-training, continual pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL). In this report, we show that when fueled with informative and high-difficulty trajectories, a simple SFT approach could be surprisingly powerful for training frontier search agents. By introducing three simple data synthesis modifications: scaling knowledge graph size for richer exploration, expanding the tool set size for broader functionality, and strict low-step filtering, we establish a stronger baseline. Trained on merely 10.6k data points, our OpenSeeker-v2 achieves state-of-the-art performance across 4 benchmarks (30B-sized agents with ReAct paradigm): 46.0% on BrowseComp, 58.1% on BrowseComp-ZH, 34.6% on Humanity's Last Exam, and 78.0% on xbench, surpassing even Tongyi DeepResearch trained with heavy CPT+SFT+RL pipeline, which achieves 43.4%, 46.7%, 32.9%, and 75.0%, respectively. Notably, OpenSeeker-v2 represents the first state-of-the-art search agent within its model scale and paradigm to be developed by a purely academic team using only SFT. We are excited to open-source the OpenSeeker-v2 model weights and share our simple yet effective findings to make frontier search agent research more accessible to the community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenSeeker-v2，仅通过简单SFT方法（使用10.6k数据点）训练搜索智能体，在4项基准测试中超越使用CPT+SFT+RL复杂流程的工业级模型，成为首个纯学术团队仅用SFT达到SOTA的搜索智能体。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM智能体的深度搜索能力目前主要由工业界主导，其训练流程资源密集（预训练、CPT、SFT、RL）。学术界受限于算力，难以复现。本文旨在探索能否通过更简单高效的方法（仅SFT）训练出具有竞争力的搜索智能体，降低研究门槛。
AI.method: 提出三项简单的数据合成改进策略：1）扩大知识图谱规模以丰富探索空间；2）扩展工具集大小以覆盖更广泛功能；3）严格低步数过滤。仅使用10.6k高质量、高难度的训练轨迹，采用纯SFT方式训练OpenSeeker-v2。
AI.result: 在4个基准测试中（30B规模ReAct范式智能体），OpenSeeker-v2取得SOTA：BrowseComp 46.0%、BrowseComp-ZH 58.1%、Humanity's Last Exam 34.6%、xbench 78.0%，全面超越使用CPT+SFT+RL复杂流程的Tongyi DeepResearch（43.4%、46.7%、32.9%、75.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 高难度、高质量的训练轨迹配合简单的SFT方法即可训练出前沿搜索智能体，无需昂贵的CPT+RL等复杂流程。这一发现有望降低搜索智能体研究的门槛，使更多学术团队能够参与该领域。

title: FluxFlow: Conservative Flow-Matching for Astronomical Image Super-Resolution
summary: Ground-to-space astronomical super-resolution requires recovering space-quality images from ground-based observations that are simultaneously limited by pixel sampling resolution and atmospheric seeing, which imposes a stochastic, spatially varying PSF that cannot be resolved through upsampling alone. Existing methods rely on synthetic training pairs that fail to capture real atmospheric statistics and are prone to either over-smoothed reconstructions or hallucination sources with no physical counterpart in the observed sky. We propose FluxFlow, a conservative pixel-space flow-matching framework that incorporates observation uncertainty and source-region importance weights during training, and a training-free Wiener-regularized test-time correction to suppress hallucination sources while preserving recovered detail. We further construct the DESI--HST Dataset, the large-scale real-world benchmark comprising 19,500 real co-registered ground-to-space image pairs with real atmospheric PSF variation. Experiments demonstrate that FluxFlow consistently outperforms existing baseline methods in both photometric and scientific accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FluxFlow，一种基于像素空间流匹配的保守框架，结合观测不确定性和源区域重要性权重进行训练，并通过无训练的维纳正则化测试时校正来抑制伪影。同时构建了包含19,500对真实地-空图像对的DESI-HST数据集。实验表明该方法在光度测量和科学准确性上均优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的地-空超分辨率方法依赖合成训练数据，无法捕捉真实大气统计特性，容易产生过度平滑的重建或幻觉源（即没有物理对应体的虚假信号）。
AI.method: 提出FluxFlow框架：1）像素空间流匹配，融入观测不确定性和源区域重要性权重进行训练；2）无训练的维纳正则化测试时校正，抑制幻觉源同时保留恢复细节；3）构建DESI-HST数据集，包含19,500对真实地-空图像对。
AI.result: FluxFlow在光度测量精度和科学准确性上均持续优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FluxFlow通过结合不确定性感知训练和测试时正则化校正，有效解决了地-空超分辨率中的幻觉源和过度平滑问题，真实数据集的构建进一步验证了方法的实际有效性。

title: Before Forgetting, Learn to Remember: Revisiting Foundational Learning Failures in LVLM Unlearning Benchmarks
summary: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) offer powerful capabilities, they pose privacy risks by unintentionally memorizing sensitive personal information. Current unlearning benchmarks attempt to mitigate this using fictitious identities but overlook a critical stage 1 failure: models fail to effectively memorize target information initially, rendering subsequent unlearning evaluations unreliable. Diagnosing under-memorization and the multi-hop curse as root causes, we introduce ReMem, a Reliable Multi-hop and Multi-image Memorization Benchmark. ReMem ensures robust foundational learning through principled data scaling, reasoning-aware QA pairs, and diverse visual contexts. Additionally, we propose a novel Exposure metric to quantify the depth of information erasure from the model's internal probability distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReMem provides a rigorous and trustworthy framework for diagnosing both learning and unlearning behaviors in LVLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReMem基准，解决LVLM中因欠记忆和多跳诅咒导致的遗忘评估不可靠问题，并引入Exposure度量来量化信息擦除深度。
AI.motivation: 现有遗忘基准使用虚构身份，但忽略了模型初始阶段未能有效记忆目标信息的关键失败（阶段1失败），导致后续遗忘评估不可靠。
AI.method: 提出ReMem基准，通过原则性数据扩展、推理感知的QA对和多样化的视觉上下文确保基础学习的稳健性；并提出Exposure度量，从模型内部概率分布量化信息擦除深度。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ReMem为诊断LVLM的学习和遗忘行为提供了严格且可信的框架。
AI.conclusion: ReMem有效解决了LVLM遗忘评估中的欠记忆和多跳诅咒问题，为隐私保护提供了更可靠的评估基准。

title: Rethinking Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Evaluating and Advancing Retrievers in Agentic Search Systems
summary: Reasoning-intensive retrieval aims to surface evidence that supports downstream reasoning rather than merely matching topical similarity. This capability is increasingly important for agentic search systems, where retrievers must provide complementary evidence across iterative search and synthesis. However, existing work remains limited on both evaluation and training: benchmarks such as BRIGHT provide narrow gold sets and evaluate retrievers in isolation, while synthetic training corpora often optimize single-passage relevance rather than evidence portfolio construction. We introduce BRIGHT-Pro, an expert-annotated benchmark that expands each query with multi-aspect gold evidence and evaluates retrievers under both static and agentic search protocols. We further construct RTriever-Synth, an aspect-decomposed synthetic corpus that generates complementary positives and positive-conditioned hard negatives, and use it to LoRA fine-tune RTriever-4B from Qwen3-Embedding-4B. Experiments across lexical, general-purpose, and reasoning-intensive retrievers show that aspect-aware and agentic evaluation expose behaviors hidden by standard metrics, while RTriever-4B substantially improves over its base model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRIGHT-Pro基准和RTriever-4B检索器，针对推理密集型检索任务，通过多方面黄金证据和智能体评估协议，显著提升了检索质量。
AI.motivation: 现有推理密集型检索在评估和训练上存在局限：基准如BRIGHT提供狭窄的黄金集且孤立评估检索器，合成训练语料优化单段落相关性而非证据组合构建。
AI.method: 构建BRIGHT-Pro专家标注基准，扩展每个查询的多方面黄金证据，在静态和智能体搜索协议下评估。构建RTriever-Synth合成语料，生成互补正例和正例条件硬负例，基于Qwen3-Embedding-4B微调得到RTriever-4B。
AI.result: 实验表明，方面感知和智能体评估能暴露标准指标隐藏的行为；RTriever-4B相比基础模型有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 方面感知与智能体评估协议更有效揭示检索器真实能力，所提方法能有效提升推理密集型检索性能。

title: GeoTopoDiff: Learning Geometry--Topology Graph Priors through Boundary-Constrained Mixed Diffusion for Sparse-Slice 3D Porous Reconstruction
summary: Diffusion-based voxel prior modelling is challenging for the reconstruction of large-scale 3D porous microstructures. Due to the demanding requirements for simultaneously modelling both the continuous pore morphology and the discrete pore-throat topology, the diffusion models require fully observed CT scans to provide topology-faithful priors, which results in an inherent trade-off among throughput, topological fidelity, and field of view in practical industrial applications. We propose GeoTopoDiff, a graph diffusion-based framework for reconstructing 3D porous microstructures from sparse CT slices. GeoTopoDiff transfers the learning of diffusion priors from a voxel-based space to a mixed graph state space, which simultaneously encompasses continuous pore geometry and discrete pore-throat topology. A topology-aware partial graph prior from sparsely observed CT slices is introduced to constrain the reverse denoising process. Experiments on anisotropic PTFE and Fontainebleau sandstone show that GeoTopoDiff reduces morphology-related errors by 19.8% and topology-sensitive transport errors by 36.5% on average. Our findings suggest that the mixed graph state space promotes the diffusion denoising process to reduce posterior uncertainty under a sparse observations. All models and code have been made publicly available to facilitate the exploration of diffusion models in the field of 3D porous microstructures simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoTopoDiff框架，将扩散先验从体素空间转移到混合图状态空间，实现从稀疏CT切片重建3D多孔微结构，同时建模连续孔隙几何和离散孔隙-喉道拓扑。
AI.motivation: 现有基于体素的扩散模型在重建大规模3D多孔微结构时，难以同时建模连续孔隙形态和离散孔隙-喉道拓扑，且需要完整CT扫描提供拓扑保真先验，导致工业应用中通量、拓扑保真度和视场之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出GeoTopoDiff框架，将扩散先验学习从体素空间转移到混合图状态空间，同时包含连续孔隙几何和离散孔隙-喉道拓扑；引入来自稀疏CT切片的拓扑感知部分图先验约束反向去噪过程。
AI.result: 在PTFE和Fontainebleau砂岩上，形态相关误差降低19.8%，拓扑敏感输运误差平均降低36.5%。
AI.conclusion: 混合图状态空间能促进扩散去噪过程，在稀疏观测下减少后验不确定性。

title: ReLeaf: Benchmarking Leaf Segmentation across Domains and Species
comment: Accepted at Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) Workshops 2026. Code and dataset available at https://github.com/cropandweed/releaf
summary: Rising global food demand and growing climate pressure increase the need for sustainable, precise agricultural practices. Automated, individualized plant treatment relies on fine-grained visual analysis, yet leaf-level segmentation remains underexplored despite its value for assessing crop health, growth dynamics, yield potential and localized stress symptoms. Progress is limited by a lack of dedicated datasets, especially regarding species coverage, and by the absence of systematic evaluations of modern instance-segmentation architectures for this task. We address these gaps by surveying current data and identifying four suitable, publicly available leaf-segmentation datasets. Using them, we compare one-stage, two-stage and Transformer-based detectors and identify a YOLO26 model configuration to provide the best trade-off for real-world precision-agriculture tasks. Extensive cross-domain generalization experiments reveal substantial performance drops across plant species and recording setups, especially for models trained solely on laboratory data. To strengthen data availability, we introduce a new benchmark dataset with leaf-level masks for 23 plant species, created via semi-automatic annotation of selected CropAndWeed images. A model trained on all four existing datasets achieves a mean mAP50-95 of 83.9% across their corresponding test sets and 40.2% on our new benchmark, demonstrating improved generalization and highlighting the need for diverse leaf-segmentation datasets in robust precision agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了现代实例分割架构在叶片分割任务中的表现，发现YOLO26模型在精度与效率间取得最佳平衡。通过引入包含23个植物物种的新基准数据集，跨域泛化实验表明实验室训练的模型在真实场景中性能显著下降，而多数据集联合训练可提升泛化能力（平均mAP50-95达83.9%）。研究强调了多样化叶片分割数据集对于稳健精准农业的重要性。
AI.motivation: 全球粮食需求增长与气候压力加剧，需要可持续的精准农业实践。自动化个体植物处理依赖于细粒度视觉分析，但叶片级分割在评估作物健康、生长动态、产量潜力和局部胁迫症状方面具有重要价值却研究不足。进展受限于缺乏专用数据集（尤其是物种覆盖不足）以及缺乏对现代实例分割架构的系统评估。
AI.method: 1）调查现有叶片分割数据，筛选出四个可公开获取的数据集；2）系统比较单阶段、双阶段和基于Transformer的检测器；3）确定YOLO26模型配置为真实世界精准农业任务提供最佳权衡；4）进行广泛的跨域泛化实验；5）引入包含23个植物物种的新基准数据集，通过半自动标注CropAndWeed图像创建；6）在所有四个现有数据集上联合训练模型。
AI.result: YOLO26模型在精度与效率间取得最佳平衡。跨域泛化实验表明，跨植物物种和记录设置时性能显著下降，尤其是仅在实验室数据上训练的模型。在四个现有数据集上联合训练的模型在其对应测试集上达到83.9%的平均mAP50-95，在新基准数据集上达到40.2%，证明了泛化能力的提升。
AI.conclusion: 叶片级分割对精准农业至关重要但研究不足；YOLO26提供最佳实践方案；跨域泛化仍是主要挑战；多样化的叶片分割数据集是构建鲁棒精准农业系统的关键；新基准数据集有助于推动该领域发展。

title: Enhancing Visual Question Answering with Multimodal LLMs via Chain-of-Question Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: With advances in multimodal research and deep learning, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for a wide range of multimodal tasks. As a core problem in vision-language research, Visual Question Answering (VQA) has increasingly employed MLLMs to improve performance, particularly in open-domain settings where external knowledge is essential. In this work, we aim to further enhance retrieval-based VQA by more effectively integrating MLLMs with structured reasoning and knowledge acquisition. We introduce a logical prompting strategy that fuses Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning with Visual Question Decomposition (VQD), termed CoVQD, to guide retrieval toward more accurate and relevant knowledge for MLLM inference. Building on this idea, we propose a new framework, CoVQD-guided RAG (CgRAG), which enables MLLMs to access more comprehensive and coherent external knowledge while benefiting from structured visual-text reasoning guidance, thereby improving generalization and reliability in complex cross-domain VQA scenarios. Extensive experiments on E-VQA, InfoSeek, and OKVQA benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出CoVQD逻辑提示策略，融合链式推理与视觉问题分解，并构建CgRAG框架增强检索式VQA在开放域场景中的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有检索式VQA在开放域场景中依赖外部知识，但缺乏有效的结构化推理与知识获取机制，导致模型泛化性和可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出CoVQD（逻辑提示策略，融合Chain-of-Thought推理与视觉问题分解），并构建CgRAG框架（CoVQD引导的检索增强生成），实现结构化视觉-文本推理指导下的更准确知识检索与MLLM推理。
AI.result: 在E-VQA、InfoSeek和OKVQA三个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过CoVQD引导的RAG框架，MLLM能够获取更全面连贯的外部知识，并在复杂跨域VQA场景中提升泛化性与可靠性。

title: Multimodal Learning on Low-Quality Data with Conformal Predictive Self-Calibration
summary: Multimodal learning often grapples with the challenge of low-quality data, which predominantly manifests as two facets: modality imbalance and noisy corruption. While these issues are often studied in isolation, we argue that they share a common root in the predictive uncertainty towards the reliability of individual modalities and instances during learning. In this paper, we propose a unified framework, termed Conformal Predictive Self-Calibration (CPSC), which leverages conformal prediction to equip the model with the ability to perform self-guided calibration on-the-fly. The core of our proposed CPSC lies in a novel self-calibrating training loop that seamlessly integrates two key modules: (1) Representation Self-Calibration, which decomposes unimodal features into components, and selectively fuses the most robust ones identified by a conformal predictor to enhance feature resilience. (2) Gradient Self-Calibration, which recalibrates the gradient flow during backpropagation based on instance-wise reliability scores, steering the optimization towards more trustworthy directions. Furthermore, we also devise a self-update strategy for the conformal predictor to ensure the entire system co-evolves consistently throughout the training process. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets under both imbalanced and noisy settings demonstrate that our CPSC framework consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/XunCHN/CPSC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架CPSC，利用共形预测实现多模态学习中模态不平衡和噪声污染问题的自校准，在六个基准数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 多模态学习中存在模态不平衡和噪声污染两大问题，以往被孤立研究，但二者根源相同——对模态和样本可靠性的预测不确定性，缺少统一解决方案。
AI.method: 提出CPSC框架，包含两个核心模块：(1)表示自校准——分解单模态特征并选择性融合鲁棒成分；(2)梯度自校准——基于样本级可靠性分数调整梯度流动。同时设计共形预测器自更新策略。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上，在数据不平衡和噪声污染两种设置下均一致优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: CPSC框架有效统一解决了多模态学习中的模态不平衡和噪声污染问题，验证了共形预测在模型自校准中的潜力。

title: Identity-Consistent Multi-Pose Generation of Contactless Fingerprints
summary: Contactless fingerprint recognition has gained increasing attention due to its advantages in hygiene and acquisition flexibility. However, the absence of physical contact constraints introduces severe nonlinear geometric distortions caused by free finger poses in 3D space, resulting in a substantial cross-modal domain gap between contactless and conventional contact-based fingerprints. Existing solutions largely rely on explicit geometric correction or image enhancement, which are fragile under extreme pose variations. In this paper, we propose Identity-Consistent Multi-Pose Generation of Contactless Fingerprints (IMPOSE), a physics-inspired framework that synthesizes identity-preserving, multi-pose contactless fingerprint samples to empower recognition models. IMPOSE consists of three stages: (1) rolled fingerprint identity generation via latent diffusion with discrete codebook representations, (2) cross-modal translation from rolled to contactless modality guided by Sauvola-based local adaptive binarization as an identity anchor, and (3) physics-based multi-pose simulation through 3D finger model texture mapping and projection. The generated samples maintain strict identity consistency at the ridge topology level and spatial alignment with standard fingerprint coordinate space. Extensive experiments on the UWA and PolyU CL2CB databases demonstrate that fine-tuning fixed-length dense descriptors (FDD) with IMPOSE-synthesized data achieves state-of-the-art cross-modal matching, reducing EER to 8.74% on UWA and 2.26% on PolyU CL2CB. Synthetic data also yields consistent gains across mainstream representations including DeepPrint and AFRNet, and the hybrid strategy combining synthetic and real data achieves the best overall results. The code and generated samples are available at https://github.com/Yu-Yy/IMPOSE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IMPOSE框架，通过三阶段合成身份保持的多姿态非接触指纹样本（潜在扩散生成卷帘指纹→跨模态翻译→物理多姿态模拟），有效缩小非接触与接触式指纹的跨模态域差距，在UWA和PolyU CL2CB数据库上实现SOTA的跨模态匹配性能（EER降至8.74%和2.26%）。
AI.motivation: 非接触指纹识别虽具有卫生和采集灵活性的优势，但缺乏物理接触约束导致自由手指姿态在3D空间中产生严重的非线性几何畸变，造成非接触式与传统接触式指纹之间存在显著的跨模态域差距。现有方法依赖于显式几何校正或图像增强，在极端姿态变化下效果脆弱。
AI.method: IMPOSE包含三阶段：(1) 通过离散码本表示的潜在扩散生成卷帘指纹身份；(2) 以Sauvola局部自适应二值化为身份锚点，从卷帘指纹到非接触模态的跨模态翻译；(3) 通过3D手指模型纹理映射和投影进行基于物理的多姿态模拟。
AI.result: 在UWA数据库上EER降至8.74%，PolyU CL2CB数据库上EER降至2.26%，超越此前SOTA。合成数据在DeepPrint、AFRNet等主流表示上均有一致性能提升，合成+真实数据的混合策略取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: IMPOSE生成的合成样本在脊线拓扑层面保持严格的身份一致性，并与标准指纹坐标空间对齐，有效解决了非接触指纹识别中的跨模态匹配难题。

title: Conditions for well-posed color recovery in scattering media
summary: Recovering scene color from images captured in scattering media is a fundamental inverse problem in optical imaging. Yet the problem is intrinsically ill-posed as multiple solutions can explain the same observation, and prediction error cannot be controlled without understanding the space of candidate solutions. Here, we present sufficient conditions under which color recovery in a scattering medium becomes well-posed. Observing that ill-posedness stems from (i) projection of spectral signals onto pixel intensities, and (ii) unknown medium parameters, we demonstrate that sensor improvements alone cannot resolve medium-induced distortions without additional constraints. We identify recovery patterns, cross-pixel relationships that naturally occur in images, and prove, for an ideal hyperspectral camera, that they restrict the solution to a unique candidate. This opens the door to a new class of vision algorithms grounded in first principles, enabling quantitative analysis of images in scattering environments.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在散射介质中，通过利用自然图像中存在的跨像素恢复模式，可以为理想高光谱相机提供颜色恢复的唯一解条件，从而将原本不适定的问题转化为适定问题。
AI.motivation: 散射介质中的颜色恢复是一个基础但不适定的逆问题，多种解可以解释同一观测结果，预测误差无法控制。作者希望找到使该问题变得适定的充分条件。
AI.method: 作者分析了不适定性的两个根源：（1）光谱信号投影到像素强度；（2）未知介质参数。然后识别出图像中自然存在的跨像素恢复模式，并在理想高光谱相机条件下证明这些模式能将解限制为唯一候选。
AI.result: 证明了仅改进传感器无法解决介质引起的颜色失真，需要额外约束。对于理想高光谱相机，自然图像中的恢复模式能提供唯一解。
AI.conclusion: 该发现为基于第一性原理的散射环境视觉算法开辟了新方向，使定量分析成为可能。

title: Parameter-Efficient Multi-View Proficiency Estimation: From Discriminative Classification to Generative Feedback
summary: Estimating how well a person performs an action, rather than which action is performed, is central to coaching, rehabilitation, and talent identification. This task is challenging because proficiency is encoded in subtle differences in timing, balance, body mechanics, and execution, often distributed across multiple views and short temporal events. We discuss three recent contributions to multi-view proficiency estimation on Ego-Exo4D. SkillFormer introduces a parameter-efficient discriminative architecture for selective multi-view fusion; PATS improves temporal sampling by preserving locally dense excerpts of fundamental movements; and ProfVLM reformulates proficiency estimation as conditional language generation, producing both a proficiency label and expert-style feedback through a gated cross-view projector and a compact language backbone. Together, these methods achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on Ego-Exo4D with up to 20x fewer trainable parameters and up to 3x fewer training epochs than video-transformer baselines, while moving from closed-set classification toward interpretable feedback generation. These results highlight a shift toward efficient, multi-view systems that combine selective fusion, proficiency-aware sampling, and actionable generative feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了三项关于多视角技能评估的最新工作（SkillFormer、PATS、ProfVLM），它们通过参数高效架构、时序采样优化和生成式反馈，在Ego-Exo4D数据集上以更少参数和训练轮次达到SOTA性能，推动了从封闭分类向可解释反馈生成的转变。
AI.motivation: 估计一个人的动作熟练程度（而非识别动作类别）在教练、康复和人才识别中至关重要，但这一任务具有挑战性，因为熟练度编码在时序、平衡、身体力学和执行细节的细微差异中，且常分布在多视角和短时事件上。
AI.method: 1. SkillFormer：提出参数高效判别架构，实现选择性多视角融合。2. PATS：通过保留局部密集的基础运动片段来改进时序采样。3. ProfVLM：将技能评估重新表述为条件语言生成，通过门控跨视角投影器和紧凑语言骨干同时生成熟练度标签和专家级反馈。
AI.result: 在Ego-Exo4D上达到SOTA准确率，可训练参数减少高达20倍，训练轮次减少高达3倍，且从封闭集分类走向可解释反馈生成。
AI.conclusion: 这些成果凸显了向高效、多视角系统的转变趋势，该系统结合了选择性融合、熟练度感知采样和可操作的生成式反馈。

title: Stream-R1: Reliability-Perplexity Aware Reward Distillation for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Distillation-based acceleration has become foundational for making autoregressive streaming video diffusion models practical, with distribution matching distillation (DMD) as the de facto choice. Existing methods, however, train the student to match the teacher's output indiscriminately, treating every rollout, frame, and pixel as equally reliable supervision. We argue that this caps distilled quality, since it overlooks two complementary axes of variance in DMD supervision: Inter-Reliability across student rollouts whose supervision varies in reliability, and Intra-Perplexity across spatial regions and temporal frames that contribute unequally to where quality can still be improved. The objective thus conflates two questions under a uniform weight: whether to learn from each rollout, and where to concentrate optimization within it. To address this, we propose Stream-R1, a Reliability-Perplexity Aware Reward Distillation framework that adaptively reweights the distillation objective at both rollout and spatiotemporal-element levels through a single shared reward-guided mechanism. At the Inter-Reliability level, Stream-R1 rescales each rollout's loss by an exponential of a pretrained video reward score, so that rollouts with reliable supervision dominate optimization. At the Intra-Perplexity level, it back-propagates the same reward model to extract per-pixel gradient saliency, which is factored into spatial and temporal weights that concentrate optimization pressure on regions and frames where refinement yields the largest expected gain. An adaptive balancing mechanism prevents any single quality axis from dominating across visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment. Stream-R1 attains consistent improvements on all three dimensions over distillation baselines on standard streaming video generation benchmarks, without architectural modification or additional inference cost.

AI.tldr: Stream-R1提出了一种可靠性-困惑度感知的奖励蒸馏框架，通过共享奖励机制在rollout和时空元素级别自适应重加权蒸馏目标，显著提升流式视频生成模型的蒸馏质量。
AI.motivation: 现有DMD蒸馏方法对所有rollout、帧和像素给予同等权重，忽略了监督信号在inter-reliability（不同rollout间可靠性差异）和intra-perplexity（空间区域和时间帧对质量改进的贡献不均）两个维度上的差异，导致蒸馏质量受限。
AI.method: 提出Stream-R1框架：1) Inter-Reliability层面，用预训练视频奖励分数的指数重新缩放每个rollout的损失；2) Intra-Perplexity层面，反向传播奖励模型提取逐像素梯度显著性，分解为空间和时间权重；3) 自适应平衡机制防止单一质量维度主导优化。
AI.result: 在标准流式视频生成基准上，Stream-R1在视觉质量、运动质量和文本对齐三个维度上均优于蒸馏基线方法，且无需架构修改或增加推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过奖励引导的自适应重加权机制，可以更有效地利用蒸馏监督信号，突破现有均匀加权策略的性能上限。

title: A Deeper Dive into the Irreversibility of PolyProtect: Making Protected Face Templates Harder to Invert
comment: Submitted to TIFS journal on 18 February 2026 (under review). Consists of: 12 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables
summary: This work presents a deeper analysis of the "irreversibility" property of PolyProtect, a biometric template protection method initially proposed for securing face embeddings. PolyProtect transforms embeddings into protected templates via multivariate polynomials, whose coefficients and exponents are distinct for each subject enrolled in the face recognition system. A polynomial is applied to consecutive sets of elements from a given embedding, where the amount of overlap between the sets is a tunable parameter. We begin our irreversibility analysis by demonstrating that PolyProtected templates are easier to invert using a numerical solver based on cosine distance, as opposed to Euclidean distance (used in the earlier PolyProtect work). To make this inversion more difficult, we then propose a "key selection algorithm", which tries to choose "keys" (coefficients and exponents of the PolyProtect polynomial) that enhance the irreversibility of PolyProtected templates, compared to when the keys are purely random. Our experiments show that this algorithm is effective at generating PolyProtected templates that are significantly more difficult to invert, and that it approximately equalises the irreversibility of PolyProtected templates generated using different "overlap" parameters. This allows for better control of the irreversibility versus accuracy trade-off, known to exist across different overlaps. We also show that accuracy in the PolyProtected domain can be affected by the range in which the embedding elements lie, but that this can be improved by normalizing the embeddings prior to applying PolyProtect. This work is reproducible using our open-source code.

AI.tldr: 本文深入分析PolyProtect生物特征模板保护方法的不可逆性，提出基于余弦距离的数值求解器进行逆向攻击，并设计密钥选择算法增强不可逆性，同时发现嵌入向量范围对精度的影响可通过归一化改善。
AI.motivation: 现有PolyProtect方法的不可逆性分析不充分，需要更深入评估其安全性，并探索如何在不牺牲精度的前提下增强保护强度。
AI.method: 1) 使用基于余弦距离的数值求解器替代欧氏距离进行逆向攻击；2) 提出密钥选择算法，优化多项式系数和指数以增强不可逆性；3) 通过归一化嵌入向量改善精度。
AI.result: 余弦距离求解器比欧氏距离更易逆向PolyProtect模板；密钥选择算法能显著提升不可逆性，并均衡不同重叠参数的不可逆性效果；嵌入归一化可提升精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过密钥选择算法和嵌入归一化，可以在不可逆性与精度之间实现更好的平衡控制，增强PolyProtect的实际安全性。

title: DMGD: Train-Free Dataset Distillation with Semantic-Distribution Matching in Diffusion Models
summary: Dataset distillation enables efficient training by distilling the information of large-scale datasets into significantly smaller synthetic datasets. Diffusion based paradigms have emerged in recent years, offering novel perspectives for dataset distillation. However, they typically necessitate additional fine-tuning stages, and effective guidance mechanisms remain underexplored. To address these limitations, we rethink diffusion based dataset distillation and propose a Dual Matching Guided Diffusion (DMGD) framework, centered on efficient training-free guidance. We first establish Semantic Matching via conditional likelihood optimization, eliminating the need for auxiliary classifiers. Furthermore, we propose a dynamic guidance mechanism that enhances the diversity of synthetic data while maintaining semantic alignment. Simultaneously, we introduce an optimal transport (OT) based Distribution Matching approach to further align with the target distribution structure. To ensure efficiency, we develop two enhanced strategies for diffusion based framework: Distribution Approximate Matching and Greedy Progressive Matching. These strategies enable effective distribution matching guidance with minimal computational overhead. Experimental results on ImageNet-Woof, ImageNet-Nette, and ImageNet-1K demonstrate that our training-free approach achieves significant improvements, outperforming state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods requiring additional fine-tuning by average accuracy gains of 2.1%, 5.4%, and 2.4%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需额外微调的双匹配引导扩散框架（DMGD），通过语义匹配、动态引导和最优传输分布匹配，在多个数据集上显著超越了需要额外微调的最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散范式用于数据集蒸馏时通常需要额外的微调阶段，且有效的引导机制研究不足。
AI.method: 提出DMGD框架，包含语义匹配（条件似然优化）、动态引导机制（增强多样性同时保持语义对齐）、基于最优传输的分布匹配，以及两种高效策略：分布近似匹配和贪心渐进匹配。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-Woof、ImageNet-Nette和ImageNet-1K上，相比需要额外微调的SOTA方法，平均准确率分别提升2.1%、5.4%和2.4%。
AI.conclusion: 无需微调的DMGD框架在数据集蒸馏任务上显著优于需要额外微调的现有方法，验证了其高效性和有效性。

title: Raising the Ceiling: Better Empirical Fixation Densities for Saliency Benchmarking
summary: Empirical fixation densities, spatial distributions estimated from human eye-tracking data, are foundational to saliency benchmarking. They directly shape benchmark conclusions, leaderboard rankings, failure case analyses, and scientific claims about human visual behavior. Yet the standard estimation method, fixed-bandwidth isotropic Gaussian KDE, has gone essentially unchanged for decades. This matters now more than ever: as the field shifts toward sample-level evaluation (failure case analysis, inverse benchmarking, per-image model comparison), reliable per-image density estimates become critical. We propose a principled mixture model that combines an adaptive-bandwidth KDE based on Abramson's method, center bias and uniform components, and a state-of-the-art saliency model, to capture different spatial and semantic types of interobserver consistency, and optimize all parameters per image via leave-one-subject-out cross-validation. Our method yields substantially higher interobserver consistency estimates across multiple benchmarks, with median per-image gains of 5-15% in log-likelihood and up to 2 percentage points in AUC. For the most affected images -- precisely those most relevant to failure case analysis -- improvements exceed 25%. We leverage these improved estimates to identify and analyze remaining failure cases of state-of-the-art saliency models, demonstrating that significant headroom for model improvement remains. More broadly, our findings highlight that empirical fixation densities should not be treated as fixed ground truths but as evolving estimates that improve with better methodology.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应带宽的混合模型来估计注视密度，相比传统固定带宽高斯KDE方法，在多项指标上获得显著提升，并揭示了现有显著性模型的改进空间。
AI.motivation: 传统的固定带宽各向同性高斯KDE方法已沿用数十年，但随着领域转向样本级评估（如失败案例分析、逆向基准测试、逐图模型比较），可靠的单图密度估计变得至关重要，现有方法已不能满足需求。
AI.method: 提出一个原则性的混合模型，结合了基于Abramson方法的自适应带宽KDE、中心偏置和均匀分量，以及一个最新显著性模型，通过留一被试交叉验证逐图优化所有参数，以捕获不同空间和语义类型的主体间一致性。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中获得了更高的主体间一致性估计，中位单图对数似然提升5-15%，AUC提升高达2个百分点；受影响最大的图像（即失败案例分析最相关的图像）改进超过25%。利用改进的估计识别并分析了最新显著性模型的剩余失败案例。
AI.conclusion: 经验注视密度不应被视为固定的地面真值，而是随着方法改进而不断演化的估计；当前最先进显著性模型仍有显著的改进空间。

title: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework
summary: Achieving Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) requires agents that learn and interact adaptively, with interactive world models providing scalable environments for perception, reasoning, and action. Yet current research still lacks large-scale datasets and unified benchmarks to evaluate their physical interaction capabilities. To address this, we propose iWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for training and testing world models on interaction-related abilities such as distance perception and memory. We construct a diverse dataset with 330k video clips and select 2.1k high-quality samples covering varied perspectives, weather, and scenes. As existing world models differ in interaction modalities, we introduce an Action Generation Framework to unify evaluation and design six task types, generating 4.9k test samples. These tasks jointly assess model performance across visual generation, trajectory following, and memory. Evaluating 14 representative world models, we identify key limitations and provide insights for future research. The iWorld-Bench model leaderboard is publicly available at iWorld-Bench.com.

AI.tldr: 本文提出iWorld-Bench，一个用于评估世界模型物理交互能力的大规模基准，包含33万视频片段、2.1k高质量样本和6种任务类型，评估了14个模型，揭示了现有模型在感知、记忆和轨迹跟随等方面的关键局限。
AI.motivation: 当前研究缺乏大规模数据集和统一基准来评估世界模型的物理交互能力，阻碍了AGI的发展。
AI.method: 构建包含33万视频片段的数据集，筛选2.1k高质量样本；引入动作生成框架统一评估，设计6种任务类型（视觉生成、轨迹跟随、记忆），生成4.9k测试样本。
AI.result: 评估了14个代表性世界模型，识别出关键局限性，并公开了排行榜。
AI.conclusion: iWorld-Bench为世界模型的交互能力评估提供了统一基准，为未来研究提供了重要洞察。

title: Reservoir property image slices from the Groningen gas field for image translation and segmentation
