summary: Reservoir characterization workflows increasingly rely on image-based and machine-learning/deep learning or even generative AI approaches, but openly available geological image datasets suitable for reproducible benchmarking remain limited. Here we describe a high-resolution dataset of reservoir-property image slices derived from the Groningen static geological model. The dataset contains aligned two-dimensional PNG images representing facies, porosity, permeability, and water saturation, generated from three-dimensional reservoir grids and prepared for downstream visualization, segmentation, and image-to-image translation tasks. In addition to the deposited original image corpus, we provide an archived software workflow for reproducing augmentation, mask generation, paired-image construction, and example baseline experiments. The resource is designed to support benchmarking of geological image analysis methods and the study of cross-domain relationships among reservoir properties. By separating the fixed image dataset from the reproducible processing workflow, this work provides a transparent foundation for reuse in geoscience, reservoir modeling, and machine-learning applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个基于格罗宁根静态地质模型的高分辨率储层属性图像数据集（包含相、孔隙度、渗透率、含水饱和度），并附带了可复现的处理工作流，用于支持地质图像分析方法的基准测试和跨域关系研究。
AI.motivation: 目前公开可用的地质图像数据集有限，难以支持可复现的基准测试，尤其是基于图像和机器学习/深度学习方法在储层表征中的应用需要标准化的开放数据资源。
AI.method: 从三维储层网格中生成对齐的二维PNG图像（相、孔隙度、渗透率、含水饱和度），并提供可复现的软件工作流（包括数据增强、掩码生成、配对图像构建和基线实验）。
AI.result: 生成了对齐的高分辨率储层属性图像数据集，并配套了完整的可复现处理工作流，支持可视化、分割和图像到图像翻译等下游任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过将固定图像数据集与可复现处理工作流分离，为地球科学、储层建模和机器学习应用提供了透明且可复用的基础资源。

title: UnAC: Adaptive Visual Prompting with Abstraction and Stepwise Checking for Complex Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Although recent LMMs have become much stronger at visual perception, they remain unreliable on problems that require multi-step reasoning over visual evidence. In this paper, we present UnAC (Understanding, Abstracting, and Checking), a multimodal prompting method that strengthens reasoning for complex multimodal tasks in LMMs (e.g., GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5, and GPT-4V). To improve image understanding and capture fine details, we propose an adaptive visual prompting strategy that enables LMMs to focus on salient regions. We further design an image-abstraction prompt to effectively extract key information from images. In addition, we introduce a gradual self-checking scheme that improves reasoning by verifying each decomposed subquestion and its answer. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks-MathVista, MM-Vet, and MMMU.

AI.tldr: UnAC是一种多模态提示方法，通过自适应视觉提示、图像抽象提示和逐步自我检查三个策略，增强LMMs（如GPT-4o）在复杂多模态任务中的多步推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LMMs在视觉感知上表现强劲，但在需要多步推理的复杂视觉任务中仍不可靠。
AI.method: 提出UnAC方法，包含：(1)自适应视觉提示策略，聚焦图像显著区域；(2)图像抽象提示，有效提取关键信息；(3)逐步自我检查机制，验证分解的子问题及答案。
AI.result: 在MathVista、MM-Vet和MMMU三个公开基准上进行了广泛实验。
AI.conclusion: UnAC方法能够有效提升LMMs在多步推理复杂多模态任务中的表现。

title: 3D Human Face Reconstruction with 3DMM face model from RGB image
summary: Nowadays as convolution neural networks demonstrate its powerful problem-solving ability in the area of image processing, efforts have been made to reconstruct detailed face shapes from 2D face images or videos. However, to make the full use of CNN, a large number of labeled data is required to train the network. Coarse morphable face model has been used to synthesize labeled data. However, it is hard for coarse morphable face models to generate photo-realistic data with detail such as wrinkles. In this project, we present a pipeline that reconstructs a human face 3D model from a single RGB image. The pipeline includes face detection, landmark detection, regression of 3DMM model parameters, and soft rendering. Mentor: Zhipeng Fan (Email: zf606@nyu.edu) Code Repository: https://github.com/SeVEnMY/3d-face- reconstruction Code Reference: https://github.com/sicxu/Deep3DFaceRecon pytorch

AI.tldr: 提出一个从单张RGB图像重建3D人脸模型的流水线，包含人脸检测、关键点检测、3DMM参数回归和软渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖大量标注数据训练CNN，而粗糙的可变形人脸模型难以生成包含皱纹等细节的逼真数据。
AI.method: 流水线包含四个步骤：人脸检测、关键点检测、3DMM模型参数回归、软渲染。
AI.result: 能够从单张RGB图像重建出带有细节的3D人脸模型。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种从单张RGB图像重建3D人脸的完整流水线，减少了对手动标注数据的依赖。

title: RD-ViT: Recurrent-Depth Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation with Reduced Data Dependence Extending the Recurrent-Depth Transformer Architecture to Dense Prediction
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve state-of-the-art segmentation accuracy but require large training datasets because each layer has unique parameters that must be learned independently. We present RD-ViT, a Recurrent-Depth Vision Transformer that adapts the Recurrent-Depth Transformer (RDT) architecture to dense prediction tasks, supporting both 2D and 3D inputs. RD-ViT replaces the deep stack of unique transformer blocks with a single shared block looped T times, augmented with LTI-stable state injection for guaranteed convergence, Adaptive Computation Time (ACT) for spatial compute allocation, depth-wise LoRA adaptation, and optional Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) feed-forward networks for category-specific specialization. We evaluate on the ACDC cardiac MRI segmentation benchmark in both 2D slice-level and 3D volumetric settings with exclusively real experiments executed in Google Colab. In 2D, RD-ViT outperforms standard ViT at 10% training data (Dice 0.774 vs 0.762) and at full data (0.882 vs 0.872). In 3D, RD-ViT with MoE achieves Dice 0.812 with 3.0M parameters, reaching 99.4% of standard ViT performance (0.817) at 53% of the parameter count. MoE expert utilization analysis reveals that different experts spontaneously specialize for different cardiac structures (RV, MYO, LV) without explicit routing supervision. ACT halting maps show higher compute allocation at cardiac boundaries, and the mean ponder time decreases from 2.6 to 1.4 iterations during training, demonstrating learned computational efficiency. Depth extrapolation enables inference with more loops than training without degradation. All code, notebooks, and results are publicly released.

AI.tldr: RD-ViT是一种循环深度视觉Transformer，通过共享循环块、状态注入和自适应计算时间等机制，在减少参数量的同时，在心脏MRI分割任务上超越标准ViT，并支持深度外推和专家专业化。
AI.motivation: 标准Vision Transformer（ViT）每层都有独立的参数，导致需要大量训练数据。本文旨在通过循环深度架构减少参数量，提高数据效率，同时保持甚至提升分割精度。
AI.method: 将深层堆叠的独立Transformer块替换为一个共享块循环T次，引入LTI稳定状态注入保证收敛、自适应计算时间（ACT）进行空间计算分配、深度LoRA适配以及可选的混合专家（MoE）前馈网络。支持2D和3D输入。
AI.result: 在ACDC心脏MRI分割任务中：2D设置下，10%数据时Dice 0.774 vs 0.762（超越标准ViT），全数据时0.882 vs 0.872。3D设置下，RD-ViT+MoE以3.0M参数（标准ViT的53%）达到Dice 0.812（标准ViT的99.4%）。MoE专家自发分工处理不同心脏结构，ACT在心脏边界分配更多计算，平均推理时间从2.6降至1.4轮。
AI.conclusion: RD-ViT通过循环深度架构有效降低了ViT的参数需求和数据依赖，在医学图像分割任务中实现了更高效、更精确的性能，并具备深度外推能力，代码已开源。

title: Large-Scale High-Quality 3D Gaussian Head Reconstruction from Multi-View Captures
summary: We propose HeadsUp, a scalable feed-forward method for reconstructing high-quality 3D Gaussian heads from large-scale multi-camera setups. Our method employs an efficient encoder-decoder architecture that compresses input views into a compact latent representation. This latent representation is then decoded into a set of UV-parameterized 3D Gaussians anchored to a neutral head template. This UV representation decouples the number of 3D Gaussians from the number and resolution of input images, enabling training with many high-resolution input views. We train and evaluate our model on an internal dataset with more than 10,000 subjects, which is an order of magnitude larger than existing multi-view human head datasets. HeadsUp achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and generalizes to novel identities without test-time optimization. We extensively analyze the scaling behavior of our model across identities, views, and model capacity, revealing practical insights for quality-compute trade-offs. Finally, we highlight the strength of our latent space by showcasing two downstream applications: generating novel 3D identities and animating the 3D heads with expression blendshapes.

AI.tldr: HeadsUp是一种可扩展的前馈方法，能从大规模多摄像机设置中重建高质量3D高斯头部模型。它采用编码器-解码器架构，将输入视图压缩为潜在表示，再解码为UV参数化的3D高斯体，在超1万人的数据集上训练，实现了无需测试时优化的最先进重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理大规模多视角设置时，3D高斯体数量受限于输入图像的数量和分辨率，且缺乏可扩展性。作者希望提出一种能处理大量高分辨率输入视图、可扩展到更多训练数据、且无需测试时优化的高效重建方法。
AI.method: 提出编码器-解码器架构，将多视角输入视图压缩为紧凑的潜在表示，然后解码为一组UV参数化的3D高斯体，这些高斯体锚定在一个中性头部模板上。UV表示解耦了高斯体数量与输入图像数量和分辨率之间的关系，支持使用大量高分辨率输入进行训练。
AI.result: 在包含超1万人的内部数据集上训练和评估（比现有多视角头部数据集大一个数量级），达到了最先进的重建质量，并能泛化到新身份而无需测试时优化。作者还分析了跨身份、视角和模型容量的扩展行为。
AI.conclusion: HeadsUp在重建质量和可扩展性方面优于现有方法，其潜在空间支持两个下游应用：生成新的3D身份和通过表情混合变形驱动3D头部动画。

title: Large Language Models are Universal Reasoners for Visual Generation
summary: Text-to-image generation has advanced rapidly with diffusion models, progressing from CLIP and T5 conditioning to unified systems where a single LLM backbone handles both visual understanding and generation. Despite the architectural unification, these systems frequently fail to faithfully align complex prompts during synthesis, even though they remain highly accurate at verifying whether an image satisfies those same prompts. We formalize this as the \emph{understanding-generation gap} and propose UniReasoner, a framework that leverages the LLM as a universal reasoner to convert its understanding strength into direct generation guidance. Given a prompt, the LLM first produces a coarse visual draft composed of discrete vision tokens. It then performs a self-critique by evaluating the draft for prompt consistency, producing a grounded textual evaluation that pinpoints what needs to be corrected. Finally, a diffusion model is conditioned jointly on the prompt, the visual draft, and the evaluation, ensuring that generation is guided by explicit corrective signals. Each signal addresses a limitation of the other: the draft provides a concrete, scene-level anchor that reduces under-specification in text-only conditioning, while the evaluation turns verification into grounded, actionable constraints that correct omissions, hallucinations, and relational errors. Experiments show that UniReasoner improves compositional alignment and semantic faithfulness under the same diffusion backbone while maintaining image quality, demonstrating a practical way to exploit LLM reasoning to close the understanding-generation gap.

AI.tldr: 提出UniReasoner框架，利用LLM作为通用推理器，通过自批评机制弥合文本理解与图像生成之间的差距，提升文本到图像生成的提示对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 现有统一架构（LLM骨干）虽能理解复杂提示，但在生成时却频繁出现对齐失败的现象，即理解-生成差距（understanding-generation gap）。作者希望利用LLM自身的理解优势来直接指导生成过程。
AI.method: 1) LLM先生成离散视觉token的粗视觉草稿；2) LLM对草稿进行自我批评，评估其与提示的一致性，输出有依据的文本评估；3) 扩散模型以提示、视觉草稿和评估为联合条件进行生成，草稿减少文本条件的欠指定问题，评估提供可操作的纠正信号。
AI.result: 在相同扩散骨干下，UniReasoner提升了组合对齐能力和语义忠实度，同时保持了图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 利用LLM推理能力是弥合理解-生成差距的有效途径，为提升文本到图像生成的提示对齐提供了实用方案。
